text.hr: Ako u raju nema cigara, ne idem tamo.
text.en: If there are no cigars in heaven, I shall not go.

text.hr: Pravilo mi je da nikad ne pušim više od jedne cigare odjednom.
text.en: I have made it a rule never to smoke more than one cigar at a time.

text.hr: Puno pijem, malo spavam i pušim cigaru za cigarom. Zato sam u dvjestopostotnoj formi.
text.en: I drink a great deal. I sleep a little, and I smoke cigar after cigar. That is why I am in two-hundred-percent form.

text.hr: Moje životno pravilo propisuje pušenje cigara i pijenje alkohola prije, poslije i, bude li potrebe, tijekom svih obroka te u razmacima između njih.
text.en: My rule of life prescribed as an absolutely sacred rite smoking cigars and also the drinking of alcohol before, after, and if need be during all meals and in the intervals between them.

text.hr: Žena je samo žena, ali dobra cigara — to je dim.
text.en: A woman is only a woman, but a good cigar is a Smoke.

text.hr: Svega previše je loše, ali previše dobrog viskija jedva je dovoljno.
text.en: Too much of anything is bad, but too much good whiskey is barely enough.

text.hr: Viski je tekuća sunčeva svjetlost.
text.en: Whisky is liquid sunshine.

text.hr: Ljubav pokreće svijet? Viski ga zavrti dvostruko brže.
text.en: Love makes the world go round? Whisky makes it go round twice as fast.

text.hr: Ništa tako ne smiruje duh kao rum i prava vjera.
text.en: There's naught, no doubt, so much the spirit calms as rum and true religion.

text.hr: Vino je jedna od najciviliziranijih stvari na svijetu.
text.en: Wine is one of the most civilized things in the world.

text.hr: Vino je sunčeva svjetlost koju na okupu drži voda.
text.en: Wine is sunlight, held together by water.

text.hr: Šampanjac: u pobjedi ga zaslužuješ, u porazu ga trebaš.
text.en: Champagne: in victory you deserve it, in defeat you need it.

text.hr: Cigara je savršen užitak: izvrsna je i ostavlja te nezadovoljnim. Što bi čovjek više htio?
text.en: A cigar is the perfect type of a perfect pleasure. It is exquisite, and it leaves one unsatisfied. What more can one want?

note.hr: parafraza iz „Slike Doriana Graya” (original o cigareti)
note.en: paraphrased from 'Dorian Gray' (original about a cigarette)

text.hr: Pušenje cigare je poput zaljubljivanja: prvo te privuče oblik, ostaneš zbog okusa, a uvijek moraš paziti da plamen ne ugasne.
text.en: Smoking a cigar is like falling in love: first you are attracted to its shape, you stay for its flavour, and you must always take care that the flame never goes out.

text.hr: Nikad ne odgađaj za sutra cigaru koju možeš popušiti danas.
text.en: Never put off till tomorrow the cigar you can smoke today.

text.hr: Uz dobru cigaru, čovjek nikad nije sam.
text.en: With a good cigar, a man is never alone.

text.hr: Cigare se ne puše u žurbi — one su mjera slobodnog vremena.
text.en: Cigars are not smoked in a hurry — they are the measure of leisure.

note.en: paraphrased from 'The Story of a Good Cigar'

text.hr: Pijem šampanjac kad pobijedim, da proslavim; i pijem ga kad izgubim, da se utješim.
text.en: I drink champagne when I win, to celebrate; and I drink champagne when I lose, to console myself.

text.hr: Uvijek nosim viski sa sobom — za slučaj da vidim zmiju. Koju također nosim sa sobom.
text.en: I always take whisky along — in case I see a snake. Which I also carry.

text.hr: Civilizacija počinje destilacijom.
text.en: Civilization begins with distillation.

text.hr: Moj daiquiri u El Floriditi, moj mojito u La Bodeguiti.
text.en: My daiquiri in El Floridita, my mojito in La Bodeguita.

text.hr: Starost je pitanje uma nad materijom: ako ti ne smeta, nije važno. Uz cigaru i čašu — još manje.
text.en: Age is a case of mind over matter. If you don't mind, it doesn't matter — even less so with a cigar and a glass.

text.hr: Ponekad je cigara samo cigara.
text.en: Sometimes a cigar is just a cigar.

text.hr: Dobar viski treba piti s poštovanjem: polako, s vodom po želji i bez žurbe.
text.en: Good whisky deserves respect: slowly, with water if you wish, and never in a hurry.

facts.hr: „Anđeoski dio” (angel's share) je alkohol koji ispari iz bačve tijekom dozrijevanja: u Škotskoj oko 2 % godišnje, a u karipskoj klimi i preko 6 %.
facts.en: The angel's share is the alcohol that evaporates from the cask: about 2% a year in Scotland, but over 6% in the Caribbean climate.

facts.hr: Ring gauge cigare izražava se u 64-inama inča: oznaka 50 na robustu znači promjer od 50/64 inča (~19,8 mm).
facts.en: A cigar's ring gauge is measured in 64ths of an inch: a robusto 50 is 50/64" (~19.8 mm) across.

facts.hr: Solera je sustav dozrijevanja u kojem se mlađa pića postupno miješaju sa starijima: broj na etiketi solere često označava najstariju, a ne prosječnu komponentu.
facts.en: A solera gradually blends younger spirit into older casks: the number on a solera label often refers to the oldest component, not the average.

facts.hr: Bourbon mora biti proizveden u SAD-u od najmanje 51 % kukuruza i dozrijevati u novim hrastovim bačvama opaljenima iznutra.
facts.en: Bourbon must be made in the USA from at least 51% corn and aged in NEW charred oak barrels.

facts.hr: Rabljene bourbon bačve ne bacaju se: u njima dozrijeva velik dio svjetskog scotcha i ruma.
facts.en: Used bourbon barrels are not thrown away: much of the world's scotch and rum matures in them.

facts.hr: Scotch mora dozrijevati najmanje 3 godine u hrastu u Škotskoj, a dob na etiketi uvijek se odnosi na najmlađi whisky u boci.
facts.en: Scotch must mature at least 3 years in oak in Scotland; the age on the label is always the YOUNGEST whisky in the bottle.

facts.hr: Treset daje dimljeni okus: mjeri se u ppm fenola. Octomore prelazi 100+ ppm, dok Laphroaig 10 ima oko 40 ppm.
facts.en: Peat gives the smoky taste, measured in phenol ppm: Octomore exceeds 100+ ppm, while Laphroaig 10 sits around 40 ppm.

facts.hr: Cognac VS znači najmanje 2 godine dozrijevanja, VSOP 4, a XO 10 godina najmlađe komponente.
facts.en: Cognac VS means at least 2 years of ageing, VSOP 4, and XO 10 for the youngest component.

facts.hr: Jamajčanski rumovi visokih estera svoju prepoznatljivu divljinu duguju dunderu: fermentiranom ostatku koji se vraća u sljedeću fermentaciju.
facts.en: High-ester Jamaican rums get their funk from dunder: fermented residue returned to the next fermentation.

facts.hr: Rhum agricole destilira se iz svježeg soka šećerne trske, a ne iz melase, pa miriše travnato i biljno.
facts.en: Rhum agricole is distilled from fresh cane juice, not molasses: hence its grassy, vegetal nose.

facts.hr: Navy strength (57 %) potječe iz doba kad su mornari provjeravali rum: barut natopljen rumom morao se i dalje zapaliti.
facts.en: Navy strength (57%) dates from sailors proofing rum: gunpowder soaked in it still had to ignite.

facts.hr: Maduro pokrov nije sorta duhana nego stupanj fermentacije: dulja i toplija fermentacija daje tamniji, slađi list.
facts.en: Maduro is not a tobacco variety but a fermentation level: longer, hotter fermentation yields a darker, sweeter leaf.

facts.hr: Puro je cigara kojoj pokrov, vezni list i punjenje dolaze iz iste zemlje: kubanske cigare uvijek su puros.
facts.en: A puro is a cigar whose wrapper, binder and filler come from one country: Cuban cigars are always puros.

facts.hr: Dijelovi cigare na španjolskom: capa (pokrov), capote (vezni list) i tripa (punjenje); majstor koji ih mota zove se torcedor.
facts.en: A cigar's parts in Spanish: capa (wrapper), capote (binder) and tripa (filler); the roller is a torcedor.

facts.hr: Vitola Churchill (7 x 47) dobila je ime po Winstonu Churchillu, koji je dnevno pušio 8–10 cigara.
facts.en: The Churchill vitola (7 x 47) is named after Winston Churchill, who smoked 8–10 cigars a day.

facts.hr: Humidor treba držati na 65–72 % relativne vlage i oko 20 °C: presuha cigara gori vruće i gorko.
facts.en: Keep a humidor at 65–72% relative humidity and about 20 °C: an over-dry cigar burns hot and bitter.

facts.hr: Cohiba je nastala 1966. kao privatna cigara Fidela Castra; u slobodnoj prodaji je tek od 1982.
facts.en: Cohiba began in 1966 as Fidel Castro's private cigar; it went on public sale only in 1982.

facts.hr: Zbog embarga iz 1962. kubanske cigare i danas su ilegalne u SAD-u, pa su procvale Dominikanska Republika, Nikaragva i Honduras.
facts.en: Due to the 1962 embargo, Cuban cigars are still illegal in the USA, which is why the Dominican Republic, Nicaragua and Honduras flourished.

facts.hr: Nikaragvanski Estelí danas proizvodi više premium cigara nego cijela Kuba.
facts.en: Estelí in Nicaragua today produces more premium cigars than the whole of Cuba.

facts.hr: Connecticut Shade pokrov uzgaja se pod mrežama koje simuliraju oblake: zato je list tanak, svijetao i blag.
facts.en: Connecticut Shade wrapper is grown under cloth that mimics cloud cover: hence the thin, pale, mild leaf.

facts.hr: „Snaga” cigare (nikotin) i „tijelo” (punoća okusa) nisu isto: cigara može biti puna okusa, a blaga nikotinom.
facts.en: A cigar's strength (nicotine) and body (flavour fullness) differ: a cigar can be full-flavoured yet mild in nicotine.

facts.hr: EU pravilo: rum smije imati najviše 20 g/L dodanog šećera. Iznad toga na etiketi mora pisati „spirit drink”.
facts.en: EU rule: rum may carry at most 20 g/L added sugar. Above that the label must read 'spirit drink'.

facts.hr: Konjaku su dopušteni šećer, karamel E150a i boisé (hrastova infuzija) do ukupno 4 % obskuracije: bez navođenja na etiketi.
facts.en: Cognac may contain sugar, E150a caramel and boisé (oak infusion) up to 4% obscuration: with no label disclosure.

facts.hr: Single malt znači: jedna destilerija + 100 % ječmeni slad. Ne znači jedna bačva (to je single cask).
facts.en: Single malt means one distillery and 100% malted barley: not one cask (that's single cask).

facts.hr: Hladna filtracija uklanja masne kiseline da whisky ne zamuti na hladnom: mnogi puristi radije biraju nefiltrirane (NCF) boce.
facts.en: Chill filtration removes fatty acids so whisky won't haze when cold: many purists prefer non-chill-filtered (NCF) bottlings.

facts.hr: Mizunara je rijedak japanski hrast koji daje note sandalovine i tamjana: bačve su toliko porozne da se koriste tek nakon posebne obuke bačvara.
facts.en: Mizunara is a rare Japanese oak lending sandalwood and incense notes: the casks are so porous that coopering them is a craft of its own.

facts.hr: Tennessee whiskey (npr. Jack Daniel's) prije bačve prolazi kroz metar drvenog ugljena javora: Lincoln County proces.
facts.en: Tennessee whiskey (e.g. Jack Daniel's) trickles through sugar-maple charcoal before barrelling: the Lincoln County process.

facts.hr: Porto je fortificiran usred fermentacije: dodani destilat (77 %) zaustavi kvasce i sačuva prirodni šećer grožđa.
facts.en: Port is fortified mid-fermentation: added grape spirit (77%) stops the yeast and preserves the grape's natural sugar.

facts.hr: Sherry se, za razliku od porta, prvo potpuno fermentira pa tek onda fortificira: zato počinje suh, a slatkoća (cream, PX) dolazi kasnijim dodacima.
facts.en: Unlike port, sherry is fully fermented first and only then fortified: it starts dry, and sweetness (cream, PX) comes from later additions.

facts.hr: Ruby porto čuva voće i boju u velikim bačvama; tawny stari oksidativno u malima i poprima boju lješnjaka i note oraha.
facts.en: Ruby port keeps fruit and colour in large vats; tawny ages oxidatively in small casks, turning hazel with walnut notes.

facts.hr: Fino sherry stari ispod flora: sloja kvasca koji ga štiti od zraka; oloroso stari bez flora pa je tamniji i puniji.
facts.en: Fino sherry ages under flor: a yeast layer shielding it from air; oloroso ages without flor, darker and fuller.

facts.hr: Pedro Ximénez (PX) radi se od grožđa sušenog na suncu: najslađe vino na svijetu, i do 500 g/L šećera.
facts.en: Pedro Ximénez (PX) is made from sun-dried grapes: the world's sweetest wine, up to 500 g/L of sugar.

facts.hr: Kalifornijski zinfandel i talijanski primitivo genetski su ista sorta: hrvatski crljenak kaštelanski (tribidrag).
facts.en: California's zinfandel and Italy's primitivo are genetically the same variety: Croatia's crljenak kaštelanski (tribidrag).

facts.hr: Prošek nije fortificiran: slatkoću dobiva od prosušenog grožđa (passito metoda), tradicionalno u Dalmaciji.
facts.en: Prošek is not fortified: its sweetness comes from dried grapes (the passito method), a Dalmatian tradition.

facts.hr: Amarone nastaje od grožđa sušenog 3–4 mjeseca (appassimento): zato ima 15+ % alkohola i note suhe višnje.
facts.en: Amarone is made from grapes dried for 3–4 months (appassimento): hence 15%+ alcohol and dried-cherry notes.

facts.hr: London Dry nije zemljopisna oznaka nego metoda: sve arome moraju doći destilacijom, bez ičega dodanog poslije (osim vode).
facts.en: London Dry is a method, not a place: all flavour must come through distillation, with nothing added afterwards (except water).

facts.hr: Gin je pravno definiran jednim sastojkom: prevladavajućom aromom borovice (juniper).
facts.en: Gin is legally defined by one ingredient: a predominant juniper flavour.

facts.hr: Kolumbova posada donijela je duhan u Europu 1492. Riječ „cigara” vjerojatno dolazi od majanske riječi „sikar” (pušiti).
facts.en: Columbus's crew brought tobacco to Europe in 1492. The word 'cigar' likely stems from the Mayan 'sikar' (to smoke).

facts.hr: Grappa se peče iz komine: kožica i sjemenki koje ostanu nakon prešanja grožđa; odležana grappa smije imati karamel.
facts.en: Grappa is distilled from pomace: the skins and seeds left after pressing wine; aged grappa may contain caramel.

facts.hr: Armagnac se najčešće destilira jednom, u kolonskom alambiku (52–60 %), pa je rustikalniji od dvaput destiliranog konjaka.
facts.en: Armagnac is usually distilled ONCE in a column alambic (52–60%), making it more rustic than twice-distilled cognac.

facts.hr: Kubanski duhan za najbolje pokrove raste u regiji Vuelta Abajo (Pinar del Río): mikroklimi koju Kubanci zovu najboljom na svijetu.
facts.en: Cuba's finest wrapper tobacco grows in Vuelta Abajo (Pinar del Río): a microclimate Cubans call the world's best.

facts.hr: Duhan za cigare fermentira u hrpama (pilónes) na 40–50 °C i po nekoliko mjeseci: bez toga bi bio oštar i neprikladan za pušenje.
facts.en: Cigar tobacco ferments in pilónes at 40–50 °C for months: without it the leaf would be harsh and unsmokable.

facts.hr: Boja pepela govori o tlu: bijeli pepeo znači tlo bogato magnezijem i kalcijem; čvrst pepeo znak je kvalitetno motane cigare.
facts.en: Ash colour reflects the soil: white ash means magnesium- and calcium-rich earth; firm ash signals a well-rolled cigar.

facts.hr: Foursquare (Barbados) destilerija Richarda Sealea globalni je predvodnik borbe za deklariranje aditiva u rumu.
facts.en: Richard Seale's Foursquare (Barbados) leads the global push for additive disclosure in rum.

facts.hr: Hampden Estate (Jamajka) objavljuje razinu estera na etiketi: od OWH (40–80) do DOK (do 1600 g/hL AA).
facts.en: Hampden Estate (Jamaica) prints ester marks on the label: from OWH (40–80) up to DOK (to 1,600 g/hL AA).

facts.hr: Doorly's je linija Foursquare destilerije na Barbadosu: ista kuća Richarda Sealea, destilat bez doziranja šećera.
facts.en: Doorly's is a Foursquare Distillery line from Barbados: Richard Seale's house, bottled without sugar dosing.

facts.hr: Dos Maderas 5+3 znači pet godina na Karibima, zatim tri godine u soleri u Jerezu, u bačvama Dos Cortados sherryja.
facts.en: Dos Maderas 5+3 means five years in the Caribbean, then three years in a Jerez solera in Dos Cortados sherry casks.

facts.hr: Admiral Rodney HMS Formidable nosi ime admiralova zastavnog broda iz bitke kod Saintesa 1782., kojom je Britanija učvrstila položaj na Karibima.
facts.en: Admiral Rodney HMS Formidable is named after the admiral's flagship at the 1782 Battle of the Saintes, which secured Britain's hold on the Caribbean.

facts.hr: Cask strength znači da je whisky pun snage ravno iz bačve, bez naknadnog razrjeđivanja vodom. Baš zato mu kap vode u čaši može otvoriti arome.
facts.en: Cask strength means the whisky is bottled at full strength straight from the cask, with no water added afterwards. That strength is exactly why a drop of water in the glass can open its aromas.

facts.hr: NAS (No Age Statement) boce nemaju istaknutu dob. Dob nije jedina mjera kvalitete, ali informacija jest vrijednost.
facts.en: NAS (No Age Statement) bottles show no age. Age isn't the only measure of quality, but disclosure has value.

facts.hr: Figurado su cigare nepravilnog oblika (torpedo, belicoso, perfecto); parejo su ravne s ravnim krajem.
facts.en: Figurados are shaped cigars (torpedo, belicoso, perfecto); parejos are straight with a flat foot.

facts.hr: Cigara se pali dugim šibicama ili plinskim upaljačem bez mirisa; benzinski upaljači prvim dimom pokvare okus.
facts.en: Light a cigar with long matches or an odourless gas lighter: petrol lighters taint the first draw.

facts.hr: Prstenovi (bands) na cigarama pojavili su se sredinom 19. stoljeća kod Gustava Bocka: navodno da bijele rukavice gospode ostanu čiste.
facts.en: Cigar bands appeared in the mid-19th century with Gustave Bock: allegedly so gentlemen's white gloves stayed clean.

facts.hr: Whisky se u boci više ne razvija: za razliku od vina, godina punjenja manje je važna od godina u bačvi.
facts.en: Whisky stops developing in the bottle: unlike wine, bottling year matters far less than years in cask.

facts.hr: „Konjak” je zaštićeno ime za brandy iz regije Cognac u Francuskoj. Talijanski Stock 84, njemački Asbach i hrvatski vinjak pripadaju svojim nacionalnim kategorijama brandyja.
facts.en: 'Cognac' is a protected name for brandy from the Cognac region of France. Italian Stock 84, German Asbach and Croatian vinjak belong to their own national brandy categories.

facts.hr: Armagnac i konjak razlikuju se destilacijom: armagnac iz Gaskonje destilira se jednom, u kolonskom alambiku, a konjak iz Charentea dvaput, u bakrenom Charentais pot stillu.
facts.en: Armagnac and cognac differ in distillation: Gascony's armagnac is distilled once in a column alambic; Charente cognac twice in a copper Charentais pot still.

facts.hr: Calvados je jabučna rakija iz Normandije: destilira se iz jabukovače (cidre), a stil Pays d'Auge prije hrasta prolazi dva prolaza kroz bakreni pot still.
facts.en: Calvados is apple spirit from Normandy: distilled from cider, and the Pays d'Auge style goes twice through a copper pot still before oak.

facts.hr: Grappa je destilat komine (kožice i sjemenke grožđa), a ne vina. Talijanska grappa (Berta, Nonino, Poli) nije ni brandy ni konjak, nego zasebna kategorija.
facts.en: Grappa is distilled from pomace (grape skins and seeds), not wine. Italian grappa (Berta, Nonino, Poli) is not brandy or cognac: it is a separate category.

facts.hr: Vinjak je hrvatski naziv za odležanu rakiju od grožđa (ili voća). Badel Vinjak XO koristi oznaku starosti XO na domaćem vinjaku.
facts.en: Vinjak is the Croatian name for aged grape (or fruit) spirit. Badel Vinjak XO uses the XO age designation on a domestic vinjak.

facts.hr: Brandy de Jerez (npr. Carlos I, Alfonso) dolazi iz Andaluzije i dozrijeva u bivšim sherry butts: američki hrast + dinamički solera sustav.
facts.en: Brandy de Jerez (e.g. Carlos I, Alfonso) comes from Andalusia and ages in former sherry butts: American oak plus a dynamic solera system.

facts.hr: Whisky (bez 'e') koriste Škotska, Kanada i Japan; whiskey (s 'e') Irska i SAD. Isto piće, različita pravopisna tradicija: nema razlike u kvaliteti.
facts.en: Whisky (no 'e') is used by Scotland, Canada and Japan; whiskey (with 'e') by Ireland and the USA. Same spirit, different spelling tradition: no quality difference.

facts.hr: Scotch mora biti destiliran i odležao najmanje 3 godine u Škotskoj. Bourbon mora biti iz SAD-a, ≥51 % kukuruza i u novim opaljenim hrastovim bačvama: to su zakonski uvjeti, ne marketing.
facts.en: Scotch must be distilled and aged at least 3 years in Scotland. Bourbon must be from the USA, ≥51% corn and in new charred oak barrels: these are legal requirements, not marketing.

facts.hr: Rum, rhum i ron nazivi su za istu kategoriju destilata na različitim jezicima: rum je engleski i općeniti naziv, rhum francuski (često agricole), a ron španjolski. Agricole je rhum iz svježeg soka trske.
facts.en: Rum, rhum and ron denote the same spirit category by language: rum (English/Spanish general), rhum (French, often agricole), ron (Spanish). Agricole is rhum from fresh cane juice.

facts.hr: Tokaji Aszú koristi ljestvicu puttonyosa (3–6): broj označava koliko košara botritiziranog grožđa ide na 136 l baze, ne godine starosti. Essencia je najrjeđa kategorija, čisti sok botritiziranog grožđa.
facts.en: Tokaji Aszú uses the puttonyos scale (3–6): the number indicates how many baskets of botrytised grapes go into 136 L of base, not years of age. Essencia is the rarest category, pure juice of botrytised grapes.

facts.hr: Prošek (HR) i Prosecco (IT) nisu isto: prošek je dalmatinsko desertno vino od prosušenog grožđa; prosecco je talijansko pjenušavo vino od sorte glera. Različita pića, slična imena.
facts.en: Prošek (HR) and Prosecco (IT) are not the same: prošek is a Dalmatian dessert wine from dried grapes; prosecco is Italian sparkling wine from the glera grape. Different drinks, similar names.

facts.hr: Champagne je zaštićeno ime samo za pjenušac iz šampanjske regije u Francuskoj. Isto piće iz drugih regija zove se pjenušac, cava (Španjolska) ili spumante (Italija).
facts.en: Champagne is a protected name only for sparkling wine from the Champagne region of France. The same style from elsewhere is called sparkling wine, cava (Spain) or spumante (Italy).

facts.hr: VS, VSOP i XO označavaju minimalnu starost najmlađe komponente (2, 4 i 10 godina). Sustav vrijedi jednako za konjak, calvados, armagnac i ostale brandyje: uvijek govori o dozrijevanju.
facts.en: VS, VSOP and XO denote the minimum age of the youngest component (2, 4 and 10 years). The system applies equally to cognac, calvados, armagnac and other brandies: it always refers to ageing.

facts.hr: Tequila mora biti iz određenih regija Meksika i najmanje 51 % agave; mezcal može biti iz više regija i često se peče iz različitih agava sorti, ponekad s dimljivim profilom.
facts.en: Tequila must come from specific regions of Mexico and be at least 51% agave; mezcal can come from more regions and is often distilled from various agave species, sometimes with a smoky profile.

facts.hr: London Dry gin nije gin iz Londona, nego metoda: sve arome moraju doći destilacijom, bez dodataka poslije (osim vode). Plymouth gin je zaštićena oznaka samo za gin iz Plymoutha, UK.
facts.en: London Dry gin is not gin from London but a method: all flavour must come through distillation, with nothing added after (except water). Plymouth gin is a protected designation only for gin from Plymouth, UK.

facts.hr: Single malt ≠ single cask: single malt znači jedna destilerija i 100 % ječmeni slad (može biti blend više bačvi). Single cask = jedna bačva, bez miješanja.
facts.en: Single malt ≠ single cask: single malt means one distillery and 100% malted barley (may blend many casks). Single cask = one barrel, no blending.

facts.hr: Cognac, Armagnac, Calvados, Scotch, Bourbon, Tequila, Champagne, Tokaji i Prošek (HR): zaštićeni nazivi koji smiju nositi samo proizvodi iz pripadajuće regije.
facts.en: Cognac, Armagnac, Calvados, Scotch, Bourbon, Tequila, Champagne, Tokaji and Prošek (HR) are protected names reserved for products from their respective regions.

facts.hr: Konjak odležava u francuskom hrastu: Limousin ima šire i poroznije godove, pa daje više tanina i začina, dok Tronçais sitnijeg zrna daje elegantniji i cvjetniji stil.
facts.en: Cognac ages in French oak: Limousin (wider, more porous grain, more tannin and spice) or Tronçais (finer grain, a more elegant, floral style).

facts.hr: U cognac chaiju (skladištu) vlažnost oblikuje stil: vlažan chai gubi više alkohola i daje mekši destilat; suh chai gubi više vode i koncentrira okus.
facts.en: In a cognac chai (warehouse), humidity shapes the style: a damp chai loses more alcohol and softens the spirit; a dry chai loses more water and concentrates flavour.

facts.hr: Armagnac ulazi u bačvu na nižem alkoholu (oko 52–60 %) od konjaka (~70 % nakon druge destilacije): zato iz hrasta izvlači više arome po godini.
facts.en: Armagnac enters the cask at lower strength (about 52–60%) than cognac (~70% after the second distillation): so it draws more flavour from the oak per year.

facts.hr: Brandy de Jerez dozrijeva u criaderas i soleri: mlađi brandy postupno se spušta kroz redove bačava i miješa sa starijim, pa je stil dinamičan, a ne statičan.
facts.en: Brandy de Jerez ages in criaderas and a solera: younger brandy gradually steps down through rows of casks, blending with older stock. A dynamic style, not a static one.

facts.hr: Kako čitati etiketu brandyja: 1) kategorija (Cognac, Armagnac, Calvados, Brandy de Jerez, vinjak…), 2) dob (VS / VSOP / XO ili godine), 3) cru ili podregija ako je navedena (npr. Grande Champagne, Pays d'Auge, Bas-Armagnac).
facts.en: How to read a brandy label: 1) category (Cognac, Armagnac, Calvados, Brandy de Jerez, vinjak…), 2) age (VS / VSOP / XO or years), 3) cru or sub-region if stated (e.g. Grande Champagne, Pays d'Auge, Bas-Armagnac).

facts.hr: „Most” u jeziku sparivanja označava zajedničku notu koja povezuje cigaru i piće: često tihu (karamela, orah, citrus), ne nužno najjaču aromu u čaši.
facts.en: In pairing language, a bridge is the shared note linking cigar and drink: often a quiet one (caramel, nut, citrus), not necessarily the loudest aroma in the glass.

facts.hr: Finish (završetak) je ono što ostane na nepcu nakon gutljaja ili zadnjeg dima; dug i suh završetak često traži drugu trećinu cigare ili kap vode.
facts.en: Finish is what lingers on the palate after a sip or last draw; a long, dry finish often calls for another third of the cigar or a drop of water.

facts.hr: Nos (miris) i nepce (okus) nisu isti organ: miris pića može obećavati slatkoću koju dim zatim zategne taninima ili začinom.
facts.en: Nose and palate are not the same: a drink's aroma can promise sweetness that smoke then tightens with tannin or spice.

facts.hr: Ritam triju gutljaja: miris pića prije dima, gutljaj nakon prve trećine i usklađivanje u drugoj; zadnja trećina često traži punije piće ili kavu.
facts.en: A tasting triple-sip rhythm: nose the drink before smoke, sip after the first third, align in the second. The final third often wants a fuller drink or coffee.

facts.hr: U Hrvatskoj prodaja duhanskih proizvoda na daljinu nije uobičajen kanal, pa se kupnja cigara planira u ovlaštenoj trgovini.
facts.en: In Croatia, distance sales of tobacco products should not be treated as the normal channel: plan to buy cigars in an authorised physical shop.

facts.hr: Specijalizirane hrvatske trgovine poput allez.hr i ecuga.com nude legalnu kupnju pića preko interneta, dok duhan u aplikaciji ostaje informacija, a kupnja se obavlja u trgovini.
facts.en: Specialist Croatian retailers such as allez.hr and ecuga.com offer legal online drinks sales; tobacco in the app remains reference and in-person purchase.

facts.hr: Don Papa s oko 29 g/L dodanog šećera prelazi europski prag od 20 g/L, pa na etiketi mora stajati „spirit drink”, a ne „rum”.
facts.en: Don Papa (~29 g/L added sugar) exceeds the EU rum cap of 20 g/L and must be labelled 'spirit drink', not 'rum'.

facts.hr: London Dry gin s citrusnim i zelenim botaničkim notama često pravi most prema laganoj cigari i filtar kavi, jer se njegova svježina lijepo odupire kremastom dimu.
facts.en: London Dry gin with citrus and green botanicals often bridges a light cigar and filter coffee: freshness against creamy smoke.

facts.hr: Espresso uz gin ili navy strength gin nakon jela klasičan je treći čin večeri: tamna čokolada i borovica nose karamelu maduro pokrova.
facts.en: Espresso after a meal with gin or Navy Strength gin is a classic 'third act': dark chocolate and juniper carry maduro wrapper caramel.

facts.hr: Botanički sastojci gina poput korijandra i kardamoma dijele začinsku obitelj s Habano pokrovom, pa kratak gin i tonik može poslužiti kao most prije jačeg destilata.
facts.en: Gin botanicals such as coriander and cardamom share the spice family with Habano wrappers: a short gin and tonic can bridge before a stronger spirit.

facts.hr: Flor (španjolski „cvijet”) je živi sloj kvasca koji se prirodno stvara na površini vina u bačvi kod nekih sherryja (fino, manzanilla). Izgleda kao bjelkasto-sivkasta skrama na vrhu vina. Nastaje jer se bačva namjerno ne napuni do vrha: na dodiru vina i zraka razvije se film kvasca (sojevi tipa Saccharomyces beticus) koji troši kisik i štiti vino od oksidacije.
facts.en: Flor (Spanish for 'flower') is a living layer of yeast that forms naturally on the surface of the wine in the cask for some sherries (fino, manzanilla). It looks like a whitish-grey film on top of the wine. It appears because the cask is deliberately left unfilled: where wine meets air a film of yeast (strains such as Saccharomyces beticus) develops, consuming oxygen and shielding the wine from oxidation.

facts.hr: Fino je najsuhlji i najsvjetliji stil sherryja: dozrijeva ispod flora (biološko starenje), pa ostaje blijedo, suho i svježe, s notama badema, kruha i soli. Pije se rashlađeno i mlado.
facts.en: Fino is the driest, palest style of sherry: it ages under flor (biological ageing), staying pale, dry and fresh, with almond, bread and saline notes. It is served chilled and young.

facts.hr: Oloroso je sherry koji dozrijeva bez flora: jače je fortificiran (oko 17 % i više), pa kvasac ne preživi i vino oksidira. Zato je tamnije, punije i orašasto, iako u osnovi suho; slatka verzija dolazi naknadnim zaslađivanjem.
facts.en: Oloroso is a sherry aged without flor: fortified higher (about 17% and up), so the yeast cannot survive and the wine oxidises. That makes it darker, fuller and nutty, though dry at heart; sweet versions are sweetened afterwards.

facts.hr: Amontillado počinje kao fino ispod flora, a onda flor odumre pa vino nastavlja dozrijevati oksidativno. Zato spaja dvije faze: svježinu badema iz finog i orašastu dubinu olorosa.
facts.en: Amontillado begins as a fino under flor, then the flor dies off and the wine continues to age oxidatively. So it bridges two stages: the almond freshness of a fino and the nutty depth of an oloroso.

facts.hr: Manzanilla je fino iz priobalnog grada Sanlúcar de Barrameda: vlažna morska klima hrani deblji flor, pa je vino još svježije i slankastije od običnog finog.
facts.en: Manzanilla is a fino from the coastal town of Sanlúcar de Barrameda: the humid sea air feeds a thicker flor, so the wine is even fresher and more saline than an ordinary fino.

facts.hr: Demerara je rum iz Gvajane, nazvan po rijeci Demerari. Destilira se na povijesnim drvenim alambicima danas jedinstvenima u svijetu, pa je taman, gust i pun nota melase, kave i suhog voća.
facts.en: Demerara is rum from Guyana, named after the Demerara River. It is distilled on historic wooden stills now unique in the world, giving a dark, thick spirit full of molasses, coffee and dried-fruit notes.

facts.hr: Cachaça je brazilski destilat iz svježeg soka šećerne trske, kao i agricole rum, ali s vlastitim pravilima i nižim rasponom alkohola. Bijela je mlada i travnata, a odležana u drvu (ouro) mekša i začinjenija.
facts.en: Cachaça is a Brazilian spirit from fresh sugar-cane juice, like agricole rum, but with its own rules and a lower alcohol range. Unaged it is grassy and fresh; aged in wood (ouro) it turns softer and spicier.

facts.hr: Oznake starosti tequile: blanco je bijela i neodležana (ili do 2 mjeseca), reposado („odmoren”) stari 2–12 mjeseci u hrastu, añejo 1–3 godine, a extra añejo 3 i više godina. Duže u hrastu znači tamnije, mekše i više vanilije.
facts.en: Tequila age labels: blanco is unaged (or up to 2 months), reposado ('rested') ages 2–12 months in oak, añejo 1–3 years, and extra añejo 3 years or more. Longer in oak means darker, smoother and more vanilla.

facts.hr: Madeira je fortificirano vino s istoimenog portugalskog otoka koje se namjerno zagrijava (estufagem) i lagano oksidira. Zato je gotovo neuništivo i nosi prepoznatljive note karamele, oraha i pečene jabuke.
facts.en: Madeira is a fortified wine from the Portuguese island of the same name, deliberately heated (estufagem) and gently oxidised. That makes it almost indestructible, with signature caramel, walnut and baked-apple notes.

facts.hr: Rye je whiskey od najmanje 51 % raži (u SAD-u). Raž mu daje suši, papreno-začinski profil, drukčiji od slađeg, kukuruznog bourbona.
facts.en: Rye is whiskey made from at least 51% rye grain (in the USA). The rye gives a drier, peppery-spicy profile, distinct from sweeter corn-based bourbon.

facts.hr: Irski single pot still stil dolazi iz jedne destilerije, od mješavine slađenog i neslađenog ječma u bakrenom pot stillu. Neslađeni ječam daje kremastu, blago začinsku teksturu prepoznatljivu za Irsku.
facts.en: The Irish single pot still style comes from one distillery, made from a mash of malted and unmalted barley in a copper pot still. The unmalted barley gives a creamy, lightly spicy texture typical of Ireland.

facts.hr: Škotske viski regije daju grubu orijentaciju stila: Islay je dimljen i tresetan, Speyside voćan i elegantan, Highlands raznolik, Lowlands lagan i cvjetan, a Campbeltown slankast i uljevit. Regija je smjernica, ne pravilo.
facts.en: Scotland's whisky regions give a rough style guide: Islay is smoky and peaty, Speyside fruity and elegant, the Highlands varied, the Lowlands light and floral, and Campbeltown briny and oily. Region is a hint, not a rule.

facts.hr: Contemporary ili New Western gin i dalje mora sadržavati borovicu, ali ona ne dominira: naprijed su drugi botanicali (citrus, cvijeće, začini). To je suprotnost klasičnom London Dry stilu u kojem borovica vodi.
facts.en: Contemporary or New Western gin must still contain juniper, but juniper does not dominate: other botanicals lead (citrus, floral, spice). It contrasts with the classic London Dry style where juniper is in front.

facts.hr: Palo cortado je rijedak sherry na razmeđu: počne kao fino ispod flora, flor rano nestane, a vino spontano krene prema olorosu. Nos mu je fin i elegantan kao amontillado, a tijelo puno i orašasto kao oloroso.
facts.en: Palo cortado is a rare in-between sherry: it starts as a fino under flor, loses the flor early, and drifts spontaneously toward oloroso. Its nose is fine and elegant like an amontillado, its body full and nutty like an oloroso.

facts.hr: „Sherry bomba” je whisky dozreo u bačvama koje su prije držale sherry (najčešće oloroso ili PX). Bačva daje note suhog voća, oraha, čokolade i začina, pa je whisky tamniji i slađi od onog iz bourbon bačve.
facts.en: A 'sherry bomb' is whisky matured in casks that previously held sherry (usually oloroso or PX). The cask lends dried fruit, walnut, chocolate and spice, so the whisky is darker and sweeter than one from a bourbon barrel.

facts.hr: Dva glavna tipa destilacije: pot still (kotlasti alambik) radi šaržno i ostavlja više okusa i teksture, dok column still (kolonski) radi kontinuirano i daje čišći, lakši destilat. Isto piće zna postojati u obje izvedbe.
facts.en: Two main types of distillation: a pot still works in batches and keeps more flavour and texture, while a column still runs continuously and gives a cleaner, lighter spirit. The same drink can exist in both forms.

facts.hr: Mezcal je meksički destilat agave kojem se srca agave (piñas) često peku u zemljanim jamama na drvenom ugljenu, pa dobiva prepoznatljiv dimni profil. Tequila je zapravo jedna vrsta mezcala, ali sa strožim pravilima i obično bez dima.
facts.en: Mezcal is a Mexican agave spirit whose agave hearts (piñas) are often roasted in earthen pits over wood charcoal, giving a signature smoky profile. Tequila is in fact one kind of mezcal, but with stricter rules and usually no smoke.

facts.hr: Punilo cigare miješa listove s različitih visina biljke: ligero s vrha daje snagu i sporo gori, seco iz sredine nosi aromu, a volado s dna pomaže gorenju. Njihov omjer oblikuje snagu i ravnotežu cigare.
facts.en: A cigar's filler blends leaves from different heights of the plant: ligero from the top gives strength and burns slowly, seco from the middle carries aroma, and volado from the bottom aids the burn. Their ratio shapes a cigar's strength and balance.

facts.hr: Candela je svijetlozeleni pokrov: list se suši brzo i na toplini koja „zaključa” klorofil, pa ostane zelen. Daje blag, travnat i pomalo sladak profil; nekad vrlo popularan u SAD-u kao „American Market Selection”.
facts.en: Candela is a bright green wrapper: the leaf is dried fast and hot in a way that 'locks in' the chlorophyll, so it stays green. It gives a mild, grassy, slightly sweet profile; once very popular in the USA as the 'American Market Selection'.

facts.hr: Plume (bloom) su sitni bijeli kristalići ulja koji se s vremenom pojave na dobro čuvanoj cigari i lako se otresu; znak su lijepog starenja. Plijesan je za razliku od toga plavo-zelena, mrljasta i loše miriše, pa je znak kvara.
facts.en: Plume (bloom) is a fine white dusting of crystallised oils that appears on a well-kept cigar over time and brushes off easily; a sign of good ageing. Mould, by contrast, is blue-green, blotchy and smells off, a sign of spoilage.

facts.hr: Box-pressed cigara ima ravne, četvrtaste bokove umjesto okruglih: dobiva ih od pritiska u kutiji ili u kalupu. Osim izgleda, ravna forma često daje malo mirniji, koncentriraniji dim.
facts.en: A box-pressed cigar has flat, squared sides instead of round: it gets them from pressure in the box or a mould. Beyond looks, the flat shape often gives a slightly calmer, more concentrated draw.

facts.hr: Corojo i Criollo dvije su klasične kubanske sorte duhana: Criollo se tradicionalno koristi za punilo i vezni list, a Corojo za pokrov. Danas su njihovi hibridi (npr. Corojo '99) prošireni po Srednjoj Americi.
facts.en: Corojo and Criollo are two classic Cuban tobacco varieties: Criollo was traditionally used for filler and binder, Corojo for the wrapper. Today their hybrids (e.g. Corojo '99) are grown across Central America.

facts.hr: Vintage porto radi se samo od jedne iznimne berbe i kratko dozrijeva u bačvi (2–3 godine), a onda desetljećima stari u boci i taloži se, pa se dekantira. Tawny za razliku od njega dugo stari u bačvi i spreman je za piti odmah.
facts.en: Vintage port is made from a single exceptional harvest and spends only 2–3 years in cask, then ages for decades in the bottle and throws a sediment, so it is decanted. A tawny, by contrast, ages long in cask and is ready to drink straight away.

facts.hr: Cream sherry nije poseban stil nego zaslađeni oloroso: suhom olorosu doda se slatko vino (najčešće PX), pa nastaje tamno, baršunasto i desertno piće. Ime nema veze s vrhnjem.
facts.en: Cream sherry is not a separate style but a sweetened oloroso: a dry oloroso is blended with sweet wine (usually PX), giving a dark, velvety dessert drink. The name has nothing to do with cream.

facts.hr: Late Bottled Vintage (LBV) porto dolazi iz jedne berbe, ali dozrijeva 4–6 godina u bačvi, pa je spreman za piti odmah i obično se ne mora dekantirati. Pristupačnija je alternativa vintage portu.
facts.en: Late Bottled Vintage (LBV) port comes from a single harvest but ages 4–6 years in cask, so it is ready to drink and usually needs no decanting. It is a more approachable alternative to vintage port.

facts.hr: Old Tom je stil gina blago zaslađen, negdje između slatkog nizozemskog genevera i suhog London Dry. Povijesni je izbor za klasične koktele poput Tom Collinsa i Martineza.
facts.en: Old Tom is a lightly sweetened style of gin, sitting between sweet Dutch genever and dry London Dry. It is the historic choice for classic cocktails like the Tom Collins and the Martinez.

facts.hr: Genever (jenever) nizozemski je predak gina: destilira se od sladne baze (moutwijn), pa je slađi, žitniji i puniji od suhog gina. Borovica je prisutna, ali nježnija.
facts.en: Genever (jenever) is the Dutch ancestor of gin: distilled from a malt base (moutwijn), it is maltier, grainier and fuller than dry gin. Juniper is present but gentler.

facts.hr: „100 % agave” na tequili znači da je sav šećer iz plave agave. Ako te oznake nema, riječ je o „mixto” tequili u kojoj je najmanje 51 % agave, a ostatak drugi šećeri. 100 % agave obično je čišća i kvalitetnija.
facts.en: '100% agave' on tequila means all the sugar comes from blue agave. Without that label it is a 'mixto', at least 51% agave with other sugars making up the rest. 100% agave is usually cleaner and finer.

facts.hr: Najveći dio mezcala radi se od agave espadín jer relativno brzo sazrijeva. Divlje agave poput tobalá rastu godinama i teško se uzgajaju, pa su mezcali od njih rjeđi i skuplji.
facts.en: Most mezcal is made from espadín agave because it matures relatively quickly. Wild agaves like tobalá take years and are hard to cultivate, so mezcals from them are rarer and pricier.

facts.hr: Retrohale je tehnika kojom dio dima nježno izdahneš kroz nos umjesto kroz usta. Nos hvata arome koje jezik ne vidi (začini, cvijeće, slatkoća), pa cigara odjednom pokaže više slojeva. Radi se malom količinom, bez naglosti.
facts.en: Retrohale is a technique where you gently exhale some smoke through the nose instead of the mouth. The nose catches aromas the tongue misses (spice, floral, sweetness), so the cigar suddenly shows more layers. Do it with a small amount, without rushing.

facts.hr: Hladni draw (cold draw) je lagano povlačenje zraka kroz još nezapaljenu cigaru. Provjerava otpor (je li draw pretvrd ili prelagan) i daje predokus nota, npr. sijena, kakaa ili slatkoće, prije nego što je zapališ.
facts.en: The cold draw is pulling air through a cigar that is not yet lit. It checks the resistance (whether the draw is too tight or too loose) and previews notes such as hay, cocoa or sweetness before you light up.

facts.hr: Klasične vitole po proporcijama: corona je uravnotežena srednja (oko 5–6 x 42–44), lonsdale je duža i tanja, a panetela vrlo tanka i elegantna. Tanji format daje svjetliji, brži dim; deblji sporiji i puniji.
facts.en: Classic vitolas by proportion: a corona is a balanced medium (about 5–6 x 42–44), a lonsdale is longer and thinner, and a panetela very thin and elegant. A thinner format gives a lighter, faster smoke; a thicker one slower and fuller.

facts.hr: Oscuro je najtamniji pokrov, dobiven najduljom i najtoplijom fermentacijom (ili duljim dozrijevanjem na biljci). Daje intenzivne, slatko-zemljane note kakaa, espressa i začina. Tamniji je od običnog madura.
facts.en: Oscuro is the darkest wrapper, produced by the longest and hottest fermentation (or longer ageing on the plant). It gives intense, sweet-earthy notes of cocoa, espresso and spice. It is darker than a regular maduro.

facts.hr: „Bottled in Bond” na američkom whiskeyju stroga je oznaka: piće mora biti iz jedne destilerije i jedne sezone, odležati najmanje 4 godine u nadziranom skladištu i biti točno 50 % alkohola. Jamstvo podrijetla iz 1897.
facts.en: 'Bottled in Bond' on American whiskey is a strict mark: the spirit must come from one distillery and one season, age at least 4 years in a supervised warehouse and be exactly 50% ABV. A guarantee of origin dating to 1897.

facts.hr: Cask finish (dvostruko dozrijevanje) znači da whisky nakon glavne bačve provede još nekoliko mjeseci ili godina u drugoj (sherry, porto, rum, vinska). Ta zadnja bačva dodaje sloj arome, ali ga ne smije potpuno prekriti.
facts.en: A cask finish (double maturation) means a whisky spends extra months or years in a second cask (sherry, port, rum, wine) after its main one. That final cask adds a layer of aroma without fully masking the whisky.

facts.hr: Plemenita plijesan (Botrytis cinerea) gljivica je koja u pravim uvjetima probuši kožicu grožđa i pusti vodu da ispari, pa se šećer i aroma koncentriraju. Stoji iza velikih slatkih vina poput Tokajija i Sauternesa.
facts.en: Noble rot (Botrytis cinerea) is a fungus that, in the right conditions, pierces the grape skin and lets water evaporate, so sugar and aroma concentrate. It is behind great sweet wines like Tokaji and Sauternes.

facts.hr: Dvije glavne vrste kave: arabica je aromatičnija, kiselkastija i slađa, dok robusta ima više kofeina, gorča je i daje gušću cremu. Klasični talijanski espresso često miješa obje.
facts.en: The two main coffee species: arabica is more aromatic, brighter and sweeter, while robusta has more caffeine, is more bitter and yields a thicker crema. Classic Italian espresso often blends both.

facts.hr: En rama je sherry punjen s malo ili nimalo filtracije i bistrenja, pa je bliži onome kako izgleda ravno iz bačve: puniji, kvasniji i „življi”. Često izlazi u sezonskim serijama.
facts.en: En rama is sherry bottled with little or no filtration or fining, so it is closer to how it tastes straight from the cask: fuller, yeastier and more 'alive'. It often comes out in seasonal releases.

facts.hr: Single quinta porto je vintage porto iz jednog imanja (quinta), obično iz godina koje nisu proglašene „klasičnom” berbom. Nudi vintage stil po pristupačnijoj cijeni i s vlastitim karakterom imanja.
facts.en: A single quinta port is a vintage port from one estate (quinta), usually from years not declared a 'classic' vintage. It offers the vintage style at a friendlier price, with the estate's own character.

facts.hr: VOS („Very Old Sherry”) i VORS („Very Old Rare Sherry”) oznake su za sherry prosječne starosti oko 20, odnosno 30 godina. To su rijetke, koncentrirane boce, obično olorosa, amontillada ili PX-a.
facts.en: VOS ('Very Old Sherry') and VORS ('Very Old Rare Sherry') mark sherries averaging about 20 and 30 years. These are rare, concentrated bottles, usually oloroso, amontillado or PX.

facts.hr: Overproof rum je rum s alkoholom iznad otprilike 57,5 % (povijesni „proof”). Intenzivan je i vruć, pa se rijetko pije čist; sjajan je za koktele i za cigare koje traže snažan protuudar.
facts.en: Overproof rum is rum above roughly 57.5% ABV (historic 'proof'). It is intense and hot, so rarely sipped neat; it shines in cocktails and with cigars that want a powerful counterpunch.

facts.hr: NOM je broj na tequili koji označava registriranu destileriju koja ju je proizvela. Više različitih marki može dijeliti isti NOM jer izlaze iz iste destilerije.
facts.en: The NOM is a number on tequila identifying the registered distillery that made it. Several different brands can share the same NOM because they come from the same distillery.

facts.hr: Tanini su spojevi iz kožice i sjemenki grožđa, te iz hrasta (bačve), koji na nepcu daju suh, stežući osjećaj (kao jak čaj). U crnom vinu i mladom destilatu daju strukturu; s vremenom omekšaju.
facts.en: Tannins are compounds from grape skins and seeds, and from oak (barrels), that give a dry, gripping feel on the palate (like strong tea). In red wine and young spirit they give structure; they soften with time.

facts.hr: Cold brew je kava natapana u hladnoj vodi 12–24 sata: blaga, slatkasta i niske kiselosti. Espresso je suprotnost: vruća voda pod tlakom u sekundama izvuče gust, intenzivan koncentrat.
facts.en: Cold brew is coffee steeped in cold water for 12–24 hours: mild, sweetish and low in acidity. Espresso is the opposite: hot water under pressure pulls a dense, intense concentrate in seconds.

facts.hr: Terroir je zbir tla, klime i mjesta koji se osjeti u piću. Zato isti stil (rum, whisky, vino, čak i duhan) drukčije zvuči iz različitih krajeva, i kad je tehnika ista.
facts.en: Terroir is the sum of soil, climate and place that shows up in the drink. That is why the same style (rum, whisky, wine, even tobacco) reads differently from different regions, even with identical technique.

facts.hr: Tri uobičajena načina rezanja kape cigare: giljotina (ravan rez, najviše otvara draw), V-rez (klin, koncentrira dim u sredinu) i punch (rupica, uži i topliji draw). Manji rez lakše je popraviti nego preveliki.
facts.en: Three common ways to cut a cigar's cap: the guillotine (a straight cut, opens the draw most), the V-cut (a wedge, focuses the smoke to the centre) and the punch (a small hole, a tighter, warmer draw). A small cut is easier to fix than too big a one.

facts.hr: Jeste li znali? Uz tri uobičajena reza postoje i škare za cigare, klinasti (casino) rez, Cuban cut (giljotina pod kutom, često na figuradu da se otvor proširi bez dubljeg ravnog reza) i pinch prstima kad nema rezača — hitna mjera, ne prvi izbor.
facts.en: Did you know? Beside the three common cuts there are also cigar scissors, a wedge (casino) cut, the Cuban cut (guillotine at an angle, often on figurados to widen the opening without a deeper straight cut) and a finger pinch when you have no cutter — an emergency move, not a first choice.

facts.hr: Paljenje počinje „tostiranjem” stopala: plamen se drži malo ispod ruba, cigara se okreće i grije dok se rub ne zažari, bez izravnog dodira plamena. Tako se izbjegne zagoren, oštar prvi dim.
facts.en: Lighting starts by 'toasting' the foot: the flame is held just below the edge and the cigar is turned and warmed until the rim glows, without the flame touching it directly. This avoids a scorched, harsh first puff.

facts.hr: Purging je nježno ispuhivanje zraka kroz cigaru kad postane vruća i gorka. Izbaci nakupljeni oštri dim, pa se okus vrati. Radi se rijetko i tiho, ne kao predstava.
facts.en: Purging is gently blowing air out through the cigar when it turns hot and bitter. It clears the built-up harsh smoke so the flavour returns. Do it rarely and quietly, not as a show.

facts.hr: Dva kraja cigare: stopalo (foot) je otvoreni kraj koji se pali, a kapa (cap, glava) zatvoreni kraj koji se reže i drži u ustima. Kapu drži tanki komadić lista (flag), pa rez mora biti tik iznad njega.
facts.en: A cigar's two ends: the foot is the open end you light, and the cap (head) is the closed end you cut and hold in your mouth. The cap is held by a small piece of leaf (the flag), so cut just above it.

facts.hr: Lancero je duga, tanka vitola (oko 7,5 x 38–40) s malom „nožicom” od pokrova. Tanak format ističe pokrov i daje elegantan, precizan dim, pa ga cijene iskusniji pušači.
facts.en: A lancero is a long, thin vitola (about 7.5 x 38–40) with a small pigtail of wrapper. The slim format highlights the wrapper and gives an elegant, precise smoke, prized by seasoned smokers.

facts.hr: Cigare se, kao i pića, „slegnu” odmaranjem: nekoliko tjedana u humidoru nakon transporta ili svježe kupnje ujednači vlagu i smiri okuse. Zato friško dostavljena cigara zna pušiti bolje nakon pauze.
facts.en: Cigars, like drinks, settle with rest: a few weeks in the humidor after shipping or a fresh purchase evens out the moisture and calms the flavours. That is why a freshly delivered cigar often smokes better after a pause.

facts.hr: Canoeing je neravnomjerno gorenje kad jedna strana cigare gori brže, pa žar poprimi oblik kanua. Uzrok je često vjetar ili nejednako paljenje. Popravlja se okretanjem cigare i kratkim dogorijevanjem sporije strane.
facts.en: Canoeing is an uneven burn where one side of the cigar burns faster, so the ember takes on a canoe shape. It is often caused by wind or an uneven light. Fix it by rotating the cigar and touching up the slower side.

facts.hr: Tunneling je suprotan problem: sredina cigare gori brže od omota, pa nastaje „tunel”, a pokrov zaostaje. Najčešće je od slabog paljenja ili prerijetkog povlačenja. Ravnomjernije paljenje i redovito povlačenje (otprilike svakih 30–60 sekundi) to sprječavaju.
facts.en: Tunneling is the opposite problem: the core burns ahead of the wrapper, forming a 'tunnel' while the wrapper lags. It usually comes from a weak light or drawing too seldom. An even light and steady draws (roughly every 30–60 seconds) prevent it.

facts.hr: Cigara se smije ponovno zapaliti ako se ugasi: otreseš pepeo, nježno ispušeš dim i ponovno „tostiraš” stopalo. U razumnoj mjeri to ne kvari okus; problem je tek dugo stajala, hladna cigara koja postaje gorka.
facts.en: A cigar may be relit if it goes out: knock off the ash, gently blow out the smoke and re-toast the foot. Within reason this does not spoil the taste; only a long-cold cigar turns bitter.

facts.hr: Cedar spill je tanka trakica španjolskog cedra kojom se pali cigara: prvo je zapališ svijećom ili šibicom, pa njome zapališ cigaru. Tako nema mirisa goriva, a cedar suptilno naglasi arome.
facts.en: A cedar spill is a thin strip of Spanish cedar used to light a cigar: you light the strip with a candle or match, then light the cigar from it. This avoids any fuel smell, and the cedar subtly lifts the aromas.

facts.hr: Cigara ima dva imena: vitola de galera je tvornički naziv formata koji koriste majstori (npr. „Julieta”), a vitola de salida trgovački naziv na kutiji (npr. „Churchill”). Isti oblik zna imati različita imena po markama.
facts.en: A cigar has two names: the vitola de galera is the factory format name used by the rollers (e.g. 'Julieta'), while the vitola de salida is the commercial name on the box (e.g. 'Churchill'). The same shape can carry different names across brands.

facts.hr: Nub je posljednji, najkraći dio cigare pri kraju pušenja. Nema pravila do kamo se puši: dok je dim ugodan i hladan, smiješ do samog kraja; kad postane vruć i oštar, to je znak da staneš.
facts.en: The nub is the last, shortest part of a cigar near the end of the smoke. There is no rule on how far to go: while the smoke stays pleasant and cool you may go to the very end; when it turns hot and harsh, that is the sign to stop.

facts.hr: Celofan (cello) na cigari propušta zrak, pa cigare mogu godinama stajati u njemu bez štete i lakše se odvajaju po marki. Cedrov omotač dodatno daje aromu. Ni jedno ni drugo ne zamjenjuje ispravnu vlagu humidora.
facts.en: The cellophane (cello) on a cigar lets air through, so cigars can rest in it for years without harm and are easier to sort by brand. A cedar sleeve adds aroma on top. Neither replaces correct humidor humidity.

facts.hr: Rakija je balkanska voćna rakija: šljivovica se peče od šljiva, a ima je i od grožđa (loza), kruške (viljamovka) ili marelice. Kao i drugi eau-de-vie, čista je i mirisna, domaći aperitiv i digestiv.
facts.en: Rakija is a Balkan fruit brandy: šljivovica is distilled from plums, with versions from grapes (loza), pear (viljamovka) or apricot. Like other eaux-de-vie it is clean and aromatic, a local aperitif and digestif.

facts.hr: Marc je francuska rakija od komine, rođak talijanske grappe: peče se od kožica i sjemenki koji ostanu nakon prešanja grožđa. Španjolska inačica zove se orujo, njemačka Trester.
facts.en: Marc is a French pomace brandy, a cousin of Italian grappa: distilled from the skins and seeds left after pressing grapes. The Spanish version is called orujo, the German one Trester.

facts.hr: Single barrel (single cask) whisky ili bourbon dolazi iz jedne jedine bačve, bez miješanja s drugima. Zato svaka boca zna malo odstupati od druge; često se navode broj bačve i datum punjenja.
facts.en: A single barrel (single cask) whisky or bourbon comes from one single cask, with no blending. So each bottling can differ slightly from the next; the cask number and bottling date are often listed.

facts.hr: New make (white dog) je bistri destilat ravno s alambika, prije bačve. Voćan je i žitni, pokazuje karakter destilerije bez hrasta. Boju i većinu poznatih aroma whisky dobiva tek dozrijevanjem.
facts.en: New make (white dog) is the clear spirit straight off the still, before the cask. Fruity and grainy, it shows the distillery's character without oak. Whisky gets its colour and most familiar aromas only from ageing.

facts.hr: Slatkoća pjenušca ide od najsuhljeg prema slađem: brut nature (bez dodanog šećera), extra brut, brut, extra dry, sec, demi-sec i doux. Većina champagnea je brut, dakle suha.
facts.en: Sparkling wine sweetness runs from driest to sweeter: brut nature (no added sugar), extra brut, brut, extra dry, sec, demi-sec and doux. Most champagne is brut, that is, dry.

facts.hr: Stupanj prženja kave mijenja profil: svijetlo prženje čuva kiselost i voćne note, srednje daje ravnotežu i karamelu, a tamno donosi gorčinu, tijelo i dimne, čokoladne tonove.
facts.en: The roast level shapes coffee: a light roast keeps acidity and fruit, a medium roast gives balance and caramel, and a dark roast brings bitterness, body and smoky, chocolatey tones.

facts.hr: Dva pristupa starenju: vintage je iz jedne berbe ili sezone, pa nosi njezin pečat. Solera nema jednu godinu: mlađe se stalno miješa sa starijim, pa je stil ujednačen iz boce u bocu.
facts.en: Two approaches to ageing: a vintage is from one harvest or season, so it carries that year's stamp. A solera has no single year: younger stock is constantly blended into older, so the style stays consistent bottle to bottle.

facts.hr: Narančasto vino (orange wine) nastaje duljom maceracijom bijelog grožđa s kožicama, kao kod crvenog. Dobiva boju jantara do bakra, tanine i začinske note koje čisto bijelo vino obično nema.
facts.en: Orange wine comes from longer skin contact with white grapes, as with red. It takes an amber to copper colour, tannin and spice notes that plain white wine usually lacks.

facts.hr: Sake je japansko piće od riže, vode, kojiija i kvasca. Junmai je bez dodanog alkohola; honjozo ima malo destilata. Servira se mlako ili hladno, ovisno o stilu, a uz cigaru traži umjerenost zbog umamija i alkohola.
facts.en: Sake is a Japanese drink from rice, water, koji and yeast. Junmai has no added alcohol; honjozo has a little distilled spirit. It is served warm or cold by style, and with a cigar it asks for restraint because of umami and alcohol.

facts.hr: Kirsch je bistra voćna rakija od trešanja (često s košticama koje daju blagu gorko-bademastu notu). Pije se hladna, neat, i često završava desert ili čokoladu uz laganiju cigaru.
facts.en: Kirsch is a clear cherry eau-de-vie (often with stones that add a light bitter-almond note). It is drunk cold, neat, and often finishes a dessert or chocolate with a lighter cigar.

facts.hr: Foreshots (glava destilacije) prvi su, oštri dijelovi destilata bogati hlapljivim spojevima. Destiler ih odvaja; u čašu idu srce (hearts) i, pažljivo, repovi. Zato „kućni” destilat bez znanja može biti neugodan i nesiguran.
facts.en: Foreshots are the first, harsh cut of a distillation, rich in volatile compounds. The distiller discards them; the glass gets the heart, and carefully the tails. That is why home distillate without skill can be unpleasant and unsafe.

facts.hr: Vermut je aromatizirano vino s biljem i korijenjem, ojačano alkoholom. Suhi (dry) ide u koktele i aperitiv; slatki (rosso) je teži. Uz cigaru radi kao most između vina i žestokog: bilje, gorčina, malo slatkoće.
facts.en: Vermouth is aromatised wine with herbs and roots, fortified with spirit. Dry suits cocktails and aperitif; rosso is heavier. With a cigar it bridges wine and spirits: herbs, bitterness, a little sweetness.

facts.hr: Biljni likeri (npr. francuski i talijanski „chartreuse-stil” ili gorki amaro-rođaci) grade se na alkoholnoj bazi s desecima biljaka. Gorčina čisti nepce nakon dima; previše šećera uz jaku cigaru brzo umara.
facts.en: Herbal liqueurs (for example French or Italian chartreuse-style or bitter amaro cousins) are built on a spirit base with dozens of botanicals. Bitterness clears the palate after smoke; too much sugar with a strong cigar tires the mouth fast.

facts.hr: Pedro Ximénez (PX) je vrlo slatki španjolski sherry od sunčanih grožđa. Gusta tekstura, suho voće i karamela. Uz maduro ili desertnu večer ide žličicom, ne kao gutljaj uz svaki dim.
facts.en: Pedro Ximénez (PX) is a very sweet Spanish sherry from sunned grapes. Thick texture, dried fruit and caramel. With a maduro or a dessert evening it works by the spoonful, not as a gulp with every puff.

facts.hr: Aquavit je skandinavski žitni ili krumpirski destilat začinjen kimom ili koprom. Čist, začinski, često ledno hladan. Uz blagu ili Connecticut cigaru drži ritam bolje nego uz teški maduro.
facts.en: Aquavit is a Scandinavian grain or potato spirit seasoned with caraway or dill. Clean, spicy, often ice-cold. With a mild or Connecticut cigar it keeps pace better than with a heavy maduro.

facts.hr: Calvados je normandijski brandy od jabuka (ponekad i krušaka). Jabuka, pečeno voće i hrast. Dobro sjeda uz srednje cigare s orahastim i voćnim notama; pretjerano slatki kokteli ga uguše.
facts.en: Calvados is Normandy apple brandy (sometimes with pear). Apple, baked fruit and oak. It sits well with medium cigars that show nut and fruit; overly sweet cocktails bury it.

facts.hr: Cognac dolazi iz strogo omeđenog kraja uz Charente i često je od uglavnom ugni blanca, destiliran u bakrenom alambiku. Armagnac je iz Gaskonje, često jednokratna destilacija u kontinuiranom stupcu, pa je rustikalniji i začinskiji.
facts.en: Cognac comes from a tightly defined Charente region and is often mostly ugni blanc, distilled in a copper pot still. Armagnac is from Gascony, often a single continuous-column pass, so it tends to taste more rustic and spicy.

facts.hr: Joven ili crystal mezcal (i tequila) ostaje neobojen ili se filtrira do bistrine: dominantni su agava i peć. Odležani (reposado, añejo) dobivaju vaniliju i hrast. Uz cigaru: joven ističe dim i bilje; añejo traži sporiji ritam.
facts.en: Joven or crystal mezcal (and tequila) stays unaged or is filtered clear: agave and oven lead. Aged styles (reposado, añejo) pick up vanilla and oak. With a cigar: joven highlights smoke and herb; añejo wants a slower pace.

facts.hr: Mosto je fermentirani sok agave prije destilacije tequile ili mezcala. Kvasac i vrijeme fermentacije grade voćne i kisele note koje kasnije osjetiš u čaši, ne samo „pečenu” agavu.
facts.en: Mosto is fermented agave juice before tequila or mezcal distillation. Yeast and fermentation time build fruit and acid notes you later taste in the glass, not only ‘roasted’ agave.

facts.hr: Aromatizirano vino (vermut, quinquina) dobiva bilje i začine u već gotovom vinu. Fortificirano vino (sherry, porto, madeira) ojačava se dodanim alkoholom radi stila i trajnosti. Nisu sinonimi, iako se ponekad preklapaju.
facts.en: Aromatised wine (vermouth, quinquina) takes herbs and spices into finished wine. Fortified wine (sherry, port, madeira) is strengthened with added spirit for style and keeping. They are not synonyms, though they sometimes overlap.

facts.hr: Anisni aperitivi (pastis, slični mediteranski stilovi) miješaju se s vodom i zamute. Svježi, biljni, malo slatki. Uz laganu jutarnju ili popodnevnu cigaru rade bolje nego uz teški večernji maduro.
facts.en: Anise aperitifs (pastis and related Mediterranean styles) cloud when water is added. Fresh, herbal, lightly sweet. They suit a mild morning or afternoon cigar better than a heavy evening maduro.

facts.hr: Torcedor (ili torcedora) ručno uvija cigare u tvornici. Cigar sommelier u restoranu ili clubu bira, predlaže i servira gostu: vlažnost, rez, paljenje, sparivanje. Različiti poslovi, isti predmet.
facts.en: A torcedor (or torcedora) hand-rolls cigars in the factory. A cigar sommelier in a restaurant or club selects, recommends and serves: humidity, cut, light, pairing. Different jobs, same subject.

facts.hr: Dvosmjerni (2-way) vlažni paketići (npr. Boveda) i otpuštaju i upijaju vlagu prema soli i vodi u membrani. Cilj je stabilan RH bez stalnog dolijevanja spužve.
facts.en: Two-way humidity packs (e.g. Boveda) both release and absorb moisture via salt and water in a membrane. The aim is steady RH without constantly topping up a sponge.

facts.hr: Cvjetanje (plume, bloom) je bijeli, suhi kristal ulja na omotu: bez mirisa plijesni, briše se. Plijesan je pamučasta, često obojena i miriše na podrum. Kad sumnjaš, odvoji cigaru i ne puši „za svaki slučaj”.
facts.en: Plume (bloom) is a white, dry oil crystal on the wrapper: no mould smell, it brushes off. Mould is cottony, often tinted and smells cellar-like. When unsure, isolate the cigar and do not smoke it ‘just in case’.

facts.hr: Na vjetru cigara gori neravnomjerno i peče jezik. Okreni leđa vjetru, skrati sesiju ili prijeđi u zavjetrinu. Uljudnost: ne puši gostima u lice i ne širi pepeo po tuđem stolu.
facts.en: In wind a cigar burns unevenly and scorches the tongue. Turn your back to the wind, shorten the session or move to shelter. Manners: do not blow smoke in guests’ faces or scatter ash on someone else’s table.

facts.hr: U klasičnoj kubanskoj tvornici uloge se dijele: sortiranje lista, ovlaživanje, uvijanje, presa, kontrola kvalitete i kutija. Gost vidi marku; majstori vide list i ritam dana.
facts.en: In a classic Cuban factory roles split: leaf sorting, moistening, rolling, pressing, quality control and boxing. Guests see the brand; craftspeople see leaf and the day’s rhythm.

facts.hr: Behike je linija unutar marke Cohiba, ne zasebna marka. Ime poznaješ s kutije; ocjene i „najbolje ikad” ostavi recenzijama, ne pravilima bontona.
facts.en: Behike is a line within the Cohiba brand, not a separate marca. You know the name from the box; leave rankings and ‘best ever’ talk to reviews, not to etiquette rules.

facts.hr: Španjolski cedar u humidoru drži miris, pomaže stabilnosti vlage i tradicionalno oblaže kutije. Nije začin za jelo: prejak miris cedra može prevladati blage cigare ako je drvo sirovo.
facts.en: Spanish cedar in a humidor holds aroma, helps humidity stability and traditionally lines boxes. It is not a food spice: raw, strong cedar smell can overpower mild cigars.

facts.hr: Novi humidor treba „začiniti”: navlaži cedar (spužva ili Boveda 2-way paketići), zatvori ga danima i pusti RH da se stabilizira prije nego što ubaciš skupu kutiju. Suhi cedar pojede vlagu iz cigara.
facts.en: A new humidor needs seasoning: moisten the cedar (sponge or Boveda 2-way packs), close it for days and let RH settle before you add an expensive box. Dry cedar steals moisture from cigars.

facts.hr: Praktičan cilj vlage u humidoru za većinu cigara je otprilike 65–72 % RH, uz sobnu temperaturu bez velikih skokova. Previsoko vodi plijesni; prenisko suši omot i otvara ga.
facts.en: A practical humidity target for most cigars is about 65–72% RH, with room temperature without big swings. Too high invites mould; too low dries and cracks the wrapper.

facts.hr: Boveda (i slični 2-way) paketići dolaze u više RH razina: 62 % često za brže gorenje i snažniji okus, 65 % za svakodnevno skladištenje, 69 % za klasičan „mekši” dim, 72 % uglavnom za začinjavanje novog humidora ili vrlo suhu klimu — ne kao trajni cilj za većinu kutija.
facts.en: Boveda (and similar 2-way) packs come in several RH levels: 62% often for a quicker burn and sharper flavour, 65% for everyday storage, 69% for a classic softer smoke, 72% mainly for seasoning a new humidor or a very dry climate — not a long-term target for most boxes.

facts.hr: Vino s plutom drži se položeno da pluto ostane vlažno i ne propušta zrak. Žestice (rum, whisky, konjak) stoje okomito: visoki alkohol može oslabiti pluto, a talog nije isti problem kao kod vina.
facts.en: Corked wine is stored on its side so the cork stays moist and airtight. Spirits (rum, whisky, cognac) stand upright: high alcohol can degrade cork, and sediment is not the same concern as with wine.

facts.hr: Highball je servirati žestoko s sodom (ili sličnim) u visokoj čaši: tijelo pića se razrijedi, a profil postaje svježiji. U aplikaciji chip Highball postoji samo kod pića kojima taj stil prirodno paše (npr. rum, gin) — ne kod vina ili kave.
facts.en: A highball is serving a spirit with soda (or similar) in a tall glass: the drink’s body thins and the profile turns fresher. In the app the Highball chip appears only for drinks that suit that style (e.g. rum, gin) — not for wine or coffee.

facts.hr: Higrometar se može ugrubo provjeriti solju: zatvorena posuda sa slanom kašom treba pokazati oko 75 % RH. Ako tvoj uređaj jako odstupa, kalibriraj ili zamijeni ga prije nego što „spašavaš” kutiju.
facts.en: A hygrometer can be roughly checked with salt: a closed jar with wet salt slurry should read about 75% RH. If yours is far off, calibrate or replace it before you ‘rescue’ a box.

facts.hr: Rotiraj zalihu: starije kutije naprijed, nove straga (FIFO). Tako se izbjegne da jedna kutija godinama stoji u kutu dok se prazne samo omiljene.
facts.en: Rotate stock: older boxes forward, new ones behind (FIFO). That way one box does not sit in a corner for years while only favourites are emptied.

facts.hr: Pepeo se ne otresa svakih deset sekundi: pusti da naraste pa nježno odloži u pepeljaru. Predugi pepeo pada na odijelo; prečesto otresanje hladi žar i kvari gorenje.
facts.en: Ash is not flicked every ten seconds: let it grow, then rest it gently in the tray. Over-long ash falls on clothes; constant flicking cools the coal and spoils the burn.

facts.hr: Ritam para: gutljaj pića ne mora ići uz svaki dim. Često je bolje nekoliko dimova, pa gutljaj, pa stanka. Tako i cigara i čaša ostaju čitljive.
facts.en: Pairing tempo: a sip need not follow every puff. Often a few puffs, then a sip, then a pause works better. Both cigar and glass stay readable.

facts.hr: Traka (band) skida se kad se ljepilo ugrije i omot omekša, obično nakon centimetra-dva. Čupanje hladne trake može potrgati pokrov. Nije sramota ostaviti je do kraja ako drži.
facts.en: The band comes off when glue warms and the wrapper softens, usually after a centimetre or two. Yanking a cold band can tear the wrapper. Leaving it on to the end is fine if it holds.

facts.hr: Triple cap je trostruko zatvaranje glave cigare tankim listićima pokrova. Cilj je uredan izgled i manje kidanja pri rezu. Nije jamstvo okusa, ali jest znak pažljivog završetka.
facts.en: A triple cap is a three-layer finish of the cigar’s head with thin wrapper pieces. The aim is a neat look and less tearing when cut. It does not guarantee flavour, but it signals careful finishing.

facts.hr: Draw: previše otvoren gori vruće; previše zatvoren peče i gasi se. Blaga masaža duž cigare ili drugi rez (ne pretjeran) ponekad pomogne. Ako je čep od duhana unutra, bolje drugu cigaru nego sila.
facts.en: Draw: too open burns hot; too tight scorches and goes out. A gentle massage along the cigar or a second cut (not excessive) sometimes helps. If a tobacco plug sits inside, another cigar beats force.

facts.hr: Vezni list (vezni list) drži punilo na okupu ispod omota. Punjenje (punilo) gradi tijelo okusa i snagu (mješavina lista po visini biljke). Pokrov je koža: miris, izgled i dio okusa.
facts.en: The binder holds the filler together under the wrapper. Filler builds body and strength (a blend of leaves by plant height). Wrapper is the skin: aroma, looks and part of the flavour.

facts.hr: Omotni listovi sortiraju se po veličini, boji i elastičnosti. Bolji „wrap” ide na vidljive cigare; manji ili s mrljama često završe kao vezni list. Boja nije jedina mjera kvalitete.
facts.en: Wrapper leaves are sorted by size, colour and elasticity. Better wraps go on show cigars; smaller or spotted leaves often become binder. Colour alone is not a quality score.

facts.hr: Čep (plug) je zbijeni duhan koji blokira draw. Simptom: gotovo nema dima iako vučeš jako. Ne forsiraj silom; drugi rez ili druga cigara spašavaju večer.
facts.en: A plug is packed tobacco that blocks the draw. Symptom: almost no smoke despite hard pulling. Do not force it; a second cut or another cigar saves the evening.

facts.hr: Ako se pokrov odvija, malo sline na prstu (ili čista voda) i nježno priljubi rub u smjeru uvijanja. Velika kidanja znače kraj sesije, ne ljepilo iz ladice.
facts.en: If the wrapper unravels, a little saliva on a finger (or clean water) and gently press the edge back in the roll direction. Big tears end the session; do not raid the desk glue.

facts.hr: Touch-up paljenje: kad jedna strana zaostaje, kratko podgrij taj rub plamenom dok se ne poravna žar. Bolje mali popravak nego pretjerano vučenje koje peče cijelu cigaru.
facts.en: Touch-up lighting: when one side lags, briefly warm that rim with the flame until the coal evens. A small fix beats over-puffing that scorches the whole cigar.

facts.hr: Kad dim postane vruć, gorak ili „prazan”, uspori: duže stanke, kraći dimovi, gutljaj vode. Temperatura u ustima često kaže više od sata na telefonu.
facts.en: When smoke turns hot, bitter or ‘empty’, slow down: longer pauses, shorter puffs, a sip of water. Mouth temperature often says more than the clock on your phone.

facts.hr: Otvorena boca žestokog (visok alkohol) traje mjesecima ako je čep dobar i stoji uspravno, dalje od sunca. Otvoreno vino i fino sherry brže gube svježinu: planiraj ih potrošiti ranije.
facts.en: An opened high-strength spirit lasts months if the cork is sound and the bottle stands upright, away from sun. Open wine and fino sherry lose freshness faster: plan to finish them sooner.

facts.hr: Čaša: tulipan ili cognac ballon skuplja aromu žestokog; tumbler više hladi i razrjeđuje s ledom; vinska čaša širi vino. Za sparivanje biraj čašu koja ne guši piće ispod dima.
facts.en: Glassware: a tulip or cognac balloon gathers spirit aroma; a tumbler chills and dilutes more with ice; a wine glass opens wine. For pairing, pick a glass that does not smother the drink under smoke.

facts.hr: Led uz žestoko i cigaru brzo razvodni okus i hladi nepce. Ponekad trebaš hladnoću; češće uz kompleksnu bačvu i maduro bolje ide malo vode ili neat gutljaj.
facts.en: Ice with spirits and a cigar quickly dilutes flavour and chills the palate. Sometimes you want the cold; more often with a complex cask and a maduro, a little water or a neat sip works better.

facts.hr: Voda je reset nepca: između jakog dima i slatkog gutljaja, ili kad se arome pomiješaju. Nezamjenjiva uz dugu sesiju, jeftinija od drugog koktela.
facts.en: Water resets the palate: between strong smoke and a sweet sip, or when aromas muddle. Essential on a long session, cheaper than a second cocktail.

facts.hr: Kongeneri su aromatični spojevi koji uz alkohol nastanu pri fermentaciji i destilaciji (esteri, viši alkoholi, tanini iz bačve). Tamna, bogata pića imaju ih više, pa nose više okusa, ali i teže „posljedice”.
facts.en: Congeners are aromatic compounds formed alongside alcohol in fermentation and distillation (esters, higher alcohols, oak tannins). Dark, rich spirits carry more of them, so more flavour, but also a heavier next day.

facts.hr: Pri destilaciji majstor dijeli tok na tri dijela: glave (oštre, hlapljive), srce (čisti, pitki dio koji se zadržava) i repove (teški, uljni). Vještina je znati gdje presjeći, jer o tome ovisi profil pića.
facts.en: In distillation the maker splits the run into three: the heads (harsh, volatile), the heart (the clean, drinkable cut that is kept) and the tails (heavy, oily). The skill is knowing where to cut, since it sets the drink's profile.

facts.hr: „Proof” je stara mjera jačine. U SAD-u je proof točno dvostruki postotak alkohola (npr. 100 proof = 50 % ABV). Nastao je iz mornaričkog testa barutom, a danas je uglavnom oznaka uz ABV.
facts.en: 'Proof' is an old measure of strength. In the USA proof is exactly twice the alcohol percentage (e.g. 100 proof = 50% ABV). It grew out of the navy's gunpowder test and today mostly sits alongside ABV as a label.

facts.hr: Malt whisky radi se od ječmenog slada u pot stillu; grain whisky od drugih žitarica (kukuruz, pšenica) u kolonskom stillu, pa je lakši i neutralniji. Blended scotch miješa oba: karakter malta i mekoću graina.
facts.en: Malt whisky is made from malted barley in a pot still; grain whisky from other grains (corn, wheat) in a column still, so it is lighter and more neutral. Blended scotch mixes both: the malt's character and the grain's smoothness.

facts.hr: Cristalino je odležana tequila (reposado, añejo ili extra añejo) koja se profiltrira kroz aktivni ugljen da izgubi boju i postane bistra. Zadrži dio hrastove mekoće, ali izgleda kao blanco.
facts.en: Cristalino is an aged tequila (reposado, añejo or extra añejo) filtered through activated charcoal to strip the colour and turn clear. It keeps some of the oak's smoothness but looks like a blanco.

facts.hr: Regija agave mijenja stil tequile: agava iz visoravni Los Altos daje slađi, voćniji i cvjetniji profil, dok ona iz nizina (Valles) oko grada Tequile daje zemljaniji, biljni i papreniji karakter.
facts.en: The agave's region shapes tequila: agave from the Los Altos highlands gives a sweeter, fruitier, more floral profile, while lowland (Valles) agave near the town of Tequila gives an earthier, herbal, peppery character.

facts.hr: Sloe gin nije pravi gin nego liker: gin se macerira s trnjinama (plodovima divlje šljive) i šećerom, pa nastaje tamnocrveno, slatko-trpko piće. Klasičan je zimski aperitiv.
facts.en: Sloe gin is not a true gin but a liqueur: gin is macerated with sloes (wild blackthorn berries) and sugar, giving a deep-red, sweet-tart drink. It is a classic winter sipper.

facts.hr: Marsala je sicilijansko fortificirano vino, poznato i iz kuhinje (umaci, zabaione). Ide od suhog (secco) do slatkog (dolce), a boje od zlatne do jantarne; starije, suhe verzije lijepo idu uz cigaru.
facts.en: Marsala is a Sicilian fortified wine, also known from the kitchen (sauces, zabaglione). It runs from dry (secco) to sweet (dolce) and gold to amber; older, dry versions pair nicely with a cigar.

facts.hr: Ledeno vino (Eiswein) radi se od grožđa koje se bere zamrznuto na trsu. Led zadrži vodu, pa se cijedi samo koncentriran, sladak sok. Rezultat je rijetko, vrlo slatko vino visoke kiselosti.
facts.en: Ice wine (Eiswein) is made from grapes harvested frozen on the vine. The ice holds back the water, so only concentrated, sweet juice is pressed out. The result is a rare, very sweet wine with high acidity.

facts.hr: „Korkasto” vino nije vino s komadićima čepa, nego mana od spoja TCA: miriše na vlažan karton, mokar pas ili podrum, a voće nestane. Nastaje u čepu i nije opasno, ali vino je pokvareno.
facts.en: A 'corked' wine is not one with bits of cork, but a fault from the compound TCA: it smells of wet cardboard, wet dog or a damp cellar, and the fruit disappears. It starts in the cork and is harmless but the wine is spoiled.

facts.hr: Barber pole je cigara s dva pokrova zavijena u spiralu (npr. Connecticut i maduro), pa izgleda kao brijački stup. Osim izgleda, spaja dva profila omota u istom dimu.
facts.en: A barber pole is a cigar with two wrappers spiralled together (e.g. Connecticut and maduro), so it looks like a barber's pole. Beyond looks, it blends two wrapper profiles in the same smoke.

facts.hr: Stopalo cigare nije uvijek ravno i otvoreno: zatvoreno stopalo (perfecto) sužava se u vršak, pa prvi dimovi ističu samo pokrov. „Čupavo” stopalo (shaggy foot) ima izložen punjenje bez pokrova za mekši start.
facts.en: A cigar's foot is not always flat and open: a closed foot (perfecto) tapers to a tip, so the first puffs show only the wrapper. A shaggy foot has exposed filler with no wrapper for a softer start.

facts.hr: Turska kava kuha se od vrlo fino mljevene kave koja se prokuha u džezvi i servira nefiltrirana, s talogom na dnu. Gusta je i jaka; ne miješa se prije nego se talog slegne.
facts.en: Turkish coffee is made from very finely ground coffee simmered in a cezve and served unfiltered, with grounds settling at the bottom. It is thick and strong; do not stir before the grounds settle.

facts.hr: Moka lonac je talijanski aparat za štednjak: para gura vruću vodu kroz mljevenu kavu i daje jak, koncentriran napitak, gušći od filtra, ali ne pod tlakom kao pravi espresso.
