facts.en: The moka pot is an Italian stovetop maker: steam pushes hot water up through the ground coffee, giving a strong, concentrated brew, thicker than filter but not under pressure like true espresso.

facts.hr: Dugave i Old Pilot's Dalmatian hrvatski su ginovi: borovica ostaje, a mediteransko bilje vodi nos. Old Pilot's nosi ružmarin i kadulju; oba drže G&T ili martini uz blažu ili srednju Habano.
facts.en: Dugave and Old Pilot's Dalmatian are Croatian gins: juniper stays, Mediterranean herbs lead the nose. Old Pilot's carries rosemary and sage; both hold a G&T or martini beside a milder or medium Habano.

q.hr: Koliko dodanog šećera rum smije imati po EU pravilima da bi se i dalje zvao „rum”?
q.en: How much added sugar may rum contain under EU rules and still be called 'rum'?

why.hr: Uredba EU 2019/787: iznad 20 g/L proizvod se označava kao „spirit drink”.
why.en: EU Regulation 2019/787: above 20 g/L the product is labelled 'spirit drink'.

q.hr: Što od navedenog whisky (EU/Scotch) SMIJE sadržavati?
q.en: Which of these may whisky (EU/Scotch) legally contain?

why.hr: Jedini dopušteni dodatak je karamel E150a za ujednačavanje boje (+ voda).
why.en: The only permitted additive is E150a caramel for colour consistency (plus water).

q.hr: Koliki je limit obskuracije (ukupnih dodataka) u konjaku?
q.en: What is the obscuration (total additives) limit in cognac?

why.hr: Šećer, E150a i boisé zajedno do 4 % obskuracije (~15 g/L), bez obveze na etiketi.
why.en: Sugar, E150a and boisé may total 4% obscuration (~15 g/L), with no labelling duty.

q.hr: Od čega se destilira rhum agricole?
q.en: What is rhum agricole distilled from?

why.hr: Zato agricole miriše travnato i biljno; većina ostalih rumova nastaje iz melase.
why.en: That's why agricole smells grassy and vegetal; most other rum is molasses-based.

q.hr: Što ring gauge 50 znači kod robusto cigare?
q.en: What does ring gauge 50 mean on a robusto?

why.hr: Ring gauge se mjeri u 64-inama inča: 50/64" je oko 19,8 mm.
why.en: Ring gauge is measured in 64ths of an inch: 50/64" is about 19.8 mm.

q.en: A maduro wrapper is…

why.hr: Maduro je stupanj fermentacije: daje tamniji, slađi list s notama kakaa.
why.en: Maduro is a fermentation level: a darker, sweeter leaf with cocoa notes.

q.en: Bourbon must contain at least…

why.hr: Uz to: proizveden u SAD-u i dozrijevan u novim opaljenim hrastovim bačvama.
why.en: Plus: made in the USA and aged in new charred oak barrels.

q.hr: Koja je minimalna starost XO konjaka?
q.en: What is the minimum age of an XO cognac?

why.hr: XO = najmlađa komponenta min. 10 godina (od 2018.); VSOP je 4, VS 2.
why.en: XO = youngest component at least 10 years (since 2018); VSOP is 4, VS 2.

q.en: Where does Jamaican rum's funk (high esters) come from?

a.en: From tropical fruit in the cask

why.hr: Dunder: fermentirani ostatak prethodne destilacije. Potiče stvaranje estera.
why.en: Dunder: fermented residue of the previous run. Drives ester creation.

q.hr: Navy strength za gin i rum označava oko…
q.en: Navy strength for gin and rum means about…

why.hr: Na 57 % barut natopljen pićem još se pali: tako je mornarica provjeravala robu.
why.en: At 57% gunpowder soaked in the spirit still ignites: the navy's proofing test.

q.en: Single malt means…

why.hr: Jedna bačva je „single cask”; single malt smije biti blend više bačvi iste destilerije.
why.en: One cask is 'single cask'; a single malt may blend many casks of one distillery.

q.hr: Dob na etiketi scotcha (npr. 12) odnosi se na…
q.en: The age on a scotch label (e.g. 12) refers to…

why.hr: Zakonski: sve u boci mora biti najmanje te dobi.
why.en: By law, everything in the bottle must be at least that old.

q.en: What is a puro?

a.hr: Cigara čiji svi listovi dolaze iz iste zemlje
a.en: A cigar whose leaves all come from one country
The strongest cigar in a line

why.hr: Kubanske cigare su uvijek puros; Opus X je slavni dominikanski puro.
why.en: Cuban cigars are always puros; Opus X is a famous Dominican puro.

q.hr: Kako se zove majstor koji mota cigare?
q.en: What is a cigar roller called?

why.hr: Torcedor; ligador je majstor koji slaže blend listova.
why.en: Torcedor; the ligador is the master who composes the leaf blend.

q.hr: U kojoj kubanskoj regiji raste najcjenjeniji duhan za pokrov?
q.en: Which Cuban region grows the most prized wrapper tobacco?

why.hr: Vuelta Abajo u provinciji Pinar del Río: mikroklima za capa listove.
why.en: Vuelta Abajo in Pinar del Río: the microclimate for capa leaves.

q.en: Fino sherry ages…

why.hr: Flor štiti vino od zraka: zato je fino svijetao, suh i slan.
why.en: Flor shields the wine from air: hence fino is pale, dry and saline.

q.hr: Koje je najslađe vino na svijetu?
q.en: Which is the world's sweetest wine?

why.hr: PX od prosušenog grožđa doseže i 500 g/L šećera.
why.en: PX from sun-dried grapes can reach 500 g/L of sugar.

q.hr: Zinfandel i primitivo genetski su ista sorta kao…
q.en: Zinfandel and primitivo are genetically the same variety as…

why.hr: Crljenak (tribidrag) je otac plavca malog, a identičan zinfandelu/primitivu.
why.en: Crljenak (tribidrag) fathered plavac mali and is identical to zinfandel/primitivo.

q.hr: Kada se portu dodaje vinski destilat?
q.en: When is grape spirit added to port?

why.hr: Destilat zaustavi kvasce pa prirodni šećer grožđa ostane u vinu.
why.en: The spirit stops the yeast, so the grape's natural sugar stays in the wine.

q.en: Prošek gets its sweetness from…

why.hr: Passito metoda: bez fortifikacije, za razliku od porta.
why.en: The passito method: no fortification, unlike port.

q.en: London Dry gin is…

a.hr: metoda: sve arome destilacijom, ništa dodano poslije
a.en: a method: all flavour by distillation, nothing added after

why.hr: Zemljopis nije bitan; poslije destilacije smije se dodati samo voda (šećer ≤0,1 g/L).
why.en: Geography is irrelevant; after distillation only water may be added (sugar ≤0.1 g/L).

q.hr: Prevladavajuća aroma koja pravno definira gin je…
q.en: The predominant flavour that legally defines gin is…

why.hr: Bez prevladavajuće borovice: nije gin.
why.en: No predominant juniper: not gin.

q.hr: Angel's share u tropima je otprilike…
q.en: The angel's share in the tropics is roughly…

a.hr: tri puta veći (6 % i više godišnje)

why.hr: Zato dvanaestogodišnji rum iz tropa djeluje zrelije od znatno starijeg whiskyja.
why.en: That's why a 12-year tropical rum 'carries' like a much older whisky.

q.hr: Solera broj na etiketi (npr. „Solera 23”) najčešće označava…
q.en: A solera number (e.g. 'Solera 23') most often indicates…

a.en: the oldest component in the system

why.hr: Prosjek je često znatno mlađi, pa se solera ne uspoređuje s whiskyjem koji na etiketi ima godine.
why.en: The average is usually far younger: don't compare soleras with age-statement whisky.

q.hr: Tko je predvodnik pokreta za deklariranje aditiva u rumu?
q.en: Who leads the push for additive disclosure in rum?

why.hr: Barbadoška Foursquare destilerija deklarira „bez aditiva” i javno zagovara transparentnost.
why.en: Barbados's Foursquare declares 'no additives' and campaigns for transparency.

q.hr: Hampden Estate na etiketu stavlja oznake poput OWH i DOK, što označavaju?
q.en: Hampden Estate prints marks like OWH and DOK, what do they denote?

why.hr: Oznake razine estera: OWH nosi 40–80, a DOK do 1600 g/hL AA. Što je broj veći, to je rum divljiji.
why.en: Ester marks: OWH is 40–80, DOK up to 1,600 g/hL AA. The higher, the funkier.

q.hr: Tennessee whiskey se od bourbona razlikuje po…
q.en: Tennessee whiskey differs from bourbon by…

a.hr: Lincoln County procesu (filtracija kroz ugljen javora)

why.hr: Prije bačve destilat prolazi kroz metar drvenog ugljena šećernog javora.
why.en: Before barrelling the spirit drips through sugar-maple charcoal.

q.hr: Koliko dugo scotch mora dozrijevati u hrastu?
q.en: How long must scotch mature in oak?

why.hr: Najmanje 3 godine u Škotskoj: inače se ne smije zvati scotch.
why.en: At least 3 years in Scotland: otherwise it cannot be called scotch.

q.en: Cask strength whisky is…

why.hr: Obično 55–65 %; kap vode otvara arome.
why.en: Typically 55–65%; a drop of water opens the aromas.

q.en: Mizunara casks come from…

why.hr: Rijedak japanski hrast: note sandalovine i tamjana.
why.en: A rare Japanese oak: sandalwood and incense notes.

q.en: Chill filtration is done so that…

why.hr: Uklanja masne kiseline; NCF boce puristi često preferiraju radi teksture.
why.en: It strips fatty acids; purists often prefer NCF bottlings for texture.

q.hr: Fenoli u tresetnom whiskyju mjere se u…
q.en: Phenols in peated whisky are measured in…

why.hr: Laphroaig 10 ~40 ppm; Octomore prelazi 100+ ppm.
why.en: Laphroaig 10 ~40 ppm; Octomore exceeds 100+ ppm.

q.en: Armagnac is traditionally distilled…

why.hr: Jedna destilacija na 52–60 % čuva više kongenera: rustikalniji profil od konjaka.
why.en: A single run at 52–60% keeps more congeners: a more rustic profile than cognac.

q.en: Grappa is distilled from…

why.hr: Destilat od vina bio bi brandy/vinjak; grappa je destilat komine.
why.en: Distilled wine would be brandy; grappa is pomace spirit.

q.hr: Amarone se radi od grožđa koje je…
q.en: Amarone is made from grapes that are…

why.hr: Appassimento koncentrira šećer: zato 15+ % alkohola i note suhe višnje.
why.en: Appassimento concentrates sugar: hence 15%+ alcohol and dried-cherry notes.

q.en: Tawny port gets its hazel colour…

a.en: from oxidative ageing in small casks

why.hr: Ruby čuva voće u velikim bačvama; tawny polako oksidira u malima.
why.en: Ruby keeps fruit in large vats; tawny slowly oxidises in small casks.

q.hr: Koja vitola nosi ime britanskog premijera?
q.en: Which vitola is named after a British prime minister?

why.hr: Churchill (7 x 47): po Winstonu, koji je pušio 8–10 cigara dnevno.
why.en: Churchill (7 x 47): after Winston, who smoked 8–10 cigars a day.

q.hr: Idealna relativna vlaga u humidoru je…
q.en: The ideal relative humidity in a humidor is…

why.hr: Presuho gori vruće i gorko; prevlažno pljesnivi i teško vuče.
why.en: Too dry burns hot and bitter; too damp moulds and draws poorly.

q.en: Cohiba began as…

a.en: an export brand for the USA

why.hr: Od 1966. samo za državni protokol; u prodaji tek od 1982.
why.en: From 1966 reserved for state protocol; on sale only from 1982.

q.hr: Zašto su Dominikanska Republika, Honduras i Nikaragva postale velesile premium cigara?
q.en: Why did the Dominican Republic, Honduras and Nicaragua become premium-cigar powers?

why.hr: Kubanski majstori i sjeme raselili su se nakon revolucije i embarga.
why.en: Cuban masters and seed dispersed after the revolution and embargo.

q.en: Connecticut Shade tobacco grows…

why.hr: Sjena daje tanak, svijetao, blag list: klasika za blage cigare.
why.en: Shade yields a thin, pale, mild leaf: the classic for gentle cigars.

q.en: The difference between a cigar's strength and body?

why.hr: Cigara može biti puna okusa, a blaga nikotinom: i obrnuto.
why.en: A cigar can be full-flavoured yet mild in nicotine: and vice versa.

q.hr: Kako se zovu tri dijela cigare (španjolski)?
q.en: What are a cigar's three parts called (Spanish)?

why.hr: Capa je pokrov, capote vezni list, a tripa punjenje. (Ligero, seco i volado nazivi su za položaj lista na biljci.)
why.en: Wrapper/binder/filler. (Ligero, seco and volado are leaf positions on the plant.)

q.en: A figurado is…

why.hr: Ravne cigare s ravnim krajem zovu se parejo.
why.en: Straight cigars with a flat foot are called parejos.

q.en: The word 'cigar' likely comes from…

why.hr: Duhan je u Europu stigao s Kolumbovim posadama 1492.
why.en: Tobacco reached Europe with Columbus's crews in 1492.

q.hr: Prstenovi (bands) na cigarama uvedeni su navodno da…
q.en: Cigar bands were allegedly introduced so that…

why.hr: Gustave Bock, 1830-e: i protiv krivotvorina.
why.en: Gustave Bock, 1830s: and to fight counterfeits.

q.hr: Bijeli, čvrst pepeo cigare znak je…
q.en: White, firm cigar ash signals…

a.hr: tla bogatog mineralima i dobre izrade

why.hr: Magnezij i kalcij u tlu izbjeljuju pepeo; čvrstoća svjedoči o motanju.
why.en: Soil magnesium and calcium whiten ash; firmness attests to the roll.

q.hr: Kojim se upaljačem NE preporučuje paliti cigaru?
q.en: Which lighter is NOT recommended for a cigar?

why.hr: Benzin ostavlja miris koji pokvari prve dimove.
why.en: Petrol leaves an odour that taints the first draws.

q.en: Whisky in a sealed bottle…

why.hr: Za razliku od vina, razvoj staje izvan bačve.
why.en: Unlike wine, development stops outside the cask.

q.en: NAS on a whisky bottle means…

why.hr: Dob nije jedina mjera kvalitete, ali deklaracija jest informacija.
why.en: Age isn't the only quality measure, but disclosure is information.

q.hr: Estelí, glavni grad premium cigara izvan Kube, nalazi se u…
q.en: Estelí, the premium-cigar capital outside Cuba, is in…

why.hr: Vulkansko tlo Estelíja daje punije, začinske cigare (Padrón, Oliva, Drew Estate…).
why.en: Estelí's volcanic soil gives fuller, spicier cigars (Padrón, Oliva, Drew Estate…).

q.en: Don Papa rum comes from…

why.hr: Neovisna mjerenja pokazuju ~29 g/L dodanog šećera: u EU „spirit drink”.
why.en: Independent tests show ~29 g/L added sugar: a 'spirit drink' in the EU.

q.hr: Koja HR sorta raste na položajima Dingač i Postup?
q.en: Which Croatian variety grows on the Dingač and Postup slopes?

why.hr: Strmi pelješki položaji uz more: najpoznatija hrvatska crna vina.
why.en: Steep seaside Pelješac sites: Croatia's most famous reds.

q.en: Cuban cigars in the USA are…

why.hr: Embargo traje od 1962. godine.
why.en: The embargo has run since 1962.

q.en: Boisé, permitted in cognac, is…

why.hr: Daje dojam duljeg dozrijevanja; ulazi u limit od 4 % obskuracije.
why.en: It mimics longer ageing; it counts toward the 4% obscuration cap.

q.en: Croatian Badel Vinjak XO is…

why.hr: Vinjak je hrvatski naziv za odležanu rakiju od grožđa; XO označava kategoriju starosti.
why.en: Vinjak is the Croatian name for aged grape spirit; XO marks an age category.

q.hr: Talijanski Stock 84 XO na etiketi je…
q.en: Italian Stock 84 XO on the label is…

why.hr: Stock 84 je talijanski brandy iz Trsta. XO na etiketi označava kategoriju starosti.
why.en: Stock 84 is Italian brandy from Trieste. XO on the label marks an age category.

q.hr: Calvados (npr. Boulard XO) je destilat od…
q.en: Calvados (e.g. Boulard XO) is distilled from…

why.hr: Jabučna rakija iz Normandije; stil Pays d'Auge dvaput se destilira u pot stillu, iz jabukovače.
why.en: Apple spirit from Normandy; the Pays d'Auge style is twice distilled from cider in a pot still.

q.hr: Brandy de Jerez (Carlos I, Alfonso) dolazi iz…
q.en: Brandy de Jerez (Carlos I, Alfonso) comes from…

why.hr: Andaluzijski brandy: odležava u bivšim sherry butts u solera sustavu.
why.en: Andalusian brandy: aged in former sherry butts in a solera system.

q.en: Whisky (no 'e') is traditionally spelled by…

why.hr: Whiskey (s 'e') koriste Irska i SAD; whisky Škotska, Kanada, Japan: pravopisna tradicija, ne kvaliteta.
why.en: Whiskey (with 'e') is Ireland and the USA; whisky is Scotland, Canada, Japan: spelling tradition, not quality.

q.hr: Iz čega se obično destilira rhum agricole (francuski „rhum”)?
q.en: Rhum agricole (French 'rhum') is usually distilled from…

why.hr: Rhum (fr.) često označava agricole; rum/ron su općenito melasni ili mješoviti.
why.en: Rhum (Fr.) often marks agricole; rum/ron are generally molasses-based or blended.

q.en: Tokaji Aszú '6 puttonyos' indicates…

a.hr: 6 košara botritiziranog grožđa na 136 l baze
a.en: 6 baskets of botrytised grapes per 136 L of base

why.hr: Puttonyos je ljestvica slatkoće (3–6), ne dob: broj košara aszú grožđa u bazi.
why.en: Puttonyos is a sweetness scale (3–6), not age: baskets of aszú grapes in the base.

q.en: Prošek (HR) and Prosecco (IT) are…

a.hr: različita pića: prošek desertni od prosušenog grožđa, prosecco pjenušac od glera
a.en: different drinks: prošek is dessert wine from dried grapes, prosecco sparkling from glera

why.hr: Slična imena, potpuno različita pića: prošek passito, prosecco metodo charmat.
why.en: Similar names, completely different drinks: prošek is passito, prosecco is charmat method.

q.hr: Naziv „Champagne” smije nositi samo pjenušac iz…
q.en: The name 'Champagne' may only be used for sparkling wine from…

why.hr: Zaštićeno zemljopisno ime; iz drugih regija: cava, spumante ili pjenušac.
why.en: A protected geographical indication; elsewhere: cava, spumante or sparkling wine.

q.hr: XO na etiketi calvadosa ili armagnaca označava…
q.en: XO on a calvados or armagnac label denotes…

a.en: that the spirit is from Cognac
the minimum age of the youngest component
the average age of all components

why.hr: VS/VSOP/XO je sustav oznaka starosti: koriste ga konjak, calvados, armagnac i ostali brandyji.
why.en: VS/VSOP/XO is an age-designation system used by cognac, calvados, armagnac and other brandies alike.

q.en: Single cask whisky means…

a.en: one distillery, blend of many casks

a.hr: jedna bačva, bez miješanja s drugim bačvama
a.en: one cask, not blended with other casks

why.hr: Single malt može biti blend bačvi iste destilerije; single cask = jedna bačva.
why.en: A single malt may blend casks from one distillery; single cask = one barrel.

q.en: Tequila must contain at least… agave

why.hr: Tequila = određene meksičke regije, min. 51 % agave; mezcal ima širi izvor i često dimljiv profil.
why.en: Tequila = specific Mexican regions, min. 51% agave; mezcal has broader sourcing and often smoke.

q.hr: Koji hrast daje konjaku više tanina i začina?
q.en: Which oak gives cognac more tannin and spice?

why.hr: Limousin ima šire i poroznije godove, pa se iz njega izvlači više; Tronçais je finiji i elegantniji.
why.en: Limousin has wider, more porous grain: more extraction. Tronçais is finer and more elegant.

q.en: A damp cognac chai (warehouse) typically…

a.hr: gubi više alkohola i mekša destilat
a.en: loses more alcohol and softens the spirit

a.hr: gubi više vode i koncentrira okus
a.en: loses more water and concentrates flavour

why.hr: Vlažan zrak: alkohol ispari brže od vode. Suh chai radi obrnuto. Koncentrira okus.
why.en: Damp air: alcohol evaporates faster than water. A dry chai does the opposite. Flavour concentrates.

q.hr: Zašto armagnac iz hrasta „uzima” više arome po godini od konjaka?
q.en: Why does armagnac draw more flavour from oak per year than cognac?

a.hr: Jer ulazi u bačvu na nižem alkoholu (52–60 %)
a.en: Because it enters the cask at lower strength (52–60%)
Because it uses only new casks
Because it is stored in the sun

why.hr: Niži ulazni ABV (jedna kolonska destilacija) znači intenzivniju interakciju s drvom.
why.en: Lower entry ABV (single column distillation) means a more intense interaction with the wood.

q.hr: Koji je prvi korak pri čitanju etikete brandyja?
q.en: What is the first step when reading a brandy label?

why.hr: Kategorija govori što piješ; tek onda dob (VS/VSOP/XO) i cru/podregija daju detalj.
why.en: Category tells you what you are drinking; only then do age (VS/VSOP/XO) and cru/sub-region add detail.

q.en: What does 'bridge' mean in pairing language?

a.hr: Zajednička nota koja povezuje cigaru i piće
a.en: A shared note linking cigar and drink
The loudest note in the glass

why.hr: Most je često tih (karamela, orah, citrus): ne mora biti dominantna aroma.
why.en: A bridge is often quiet (caramel, nut, citrus): it need not be the dominant aroma.

q.en: In tasting, finish means…

a.hr: Ono što ostane na nepcu nakon gutljaja ili dima
a.en: What lingers on the palate after a sip or draw
The last sip of the evening

why.hr: Dug, suh finish često traži drugu trećinu ili kap vode.
why.en: A long, dry finish often calls for another third or a drop of water.

q.hr: Degustacijski ritam „miris → gutljaj → dim” najčešće počinje…
q.en: The tasting rhythm 'nose → sip → smoke' usually starts with…

a.en: Nosing the drink before the first draw

why.hr: Znaš odakle krećeš; druga trećina je često srce mosta.
why.en: You know where you start; the second third is often the heart of the bridge.

q.hr: Kupnja cigare u Hrvatskoj normalno je…
q.en: Buying cigars in Croatia is normally…

why.hr: Na prodaju duhana na daljinu u Hrvatskoj se ne treba oslanjati.
why.en: Distance sales of tobacco are not a channel to rely on.

q.hr: Koja RH razina Boveda paketića najčešće služi za začinjavanje novog humidora?
q.en: Which Boveda pack RH level is most often used to season a new humidor?

why.hr: 72 % često ide za seasoning ili vrlo suhu klimu; za svakodnevno skladištenje češći su 65 % ili 69 %.
why.en: 72% is often for seasoning or a very dry climate; everyday storage more often uses 65% or 69%.

q.hr: Don Papa u EU zbog šećera na etiketi često nosi oznaku…
q.en: Don Papa in the EU often carries the label… because of sugar

why.hr: ~29 g/L prelazi EU prag od 20 g/L za naziv „rum”.
why.en: ~29 g/L exceeds the EU 20 g/L cap for the name 'rum'.

q.hr: Filtar kava uz laganu cigaru i London Dry gin često radi jer…
q.en: Filter coffee with a light cigar and London Dry gin often works because…

a.hr: svježina kave i botanika gina odupiru se kremastom dimu
a.en: coffee freshness and botanicals contrast creamy smoke

why.hr: Citrusni i zeleni botanički sastojci uz blagu kavu čine most, a ne natjecanje.
why.en: Citrus and green botanicals + mild coffee = a bridge, not a contest.

q.hr: Espresso nakon jela s ginom klasično je…
q.en: Espresso after a meal with gin is classically…

a.en: a substitute for water during smoke

a.hr: treći čin, nakon pića za sparivanje i cigare
a.en: a third act after the pairing drink and cigar

why.hr: Tamna čokolada i borovica nose karamelu maduro cigare, pa espresso dolazi na kraju večeri.
why.en: Dark chocolate and juniper carry maduro caramel: after the main table.

q.hr: Korijandar u ginu dijeli obitelj nota s…
q.en: Coriander in gin shares a note family with…

why.hr: Povezuje ih začinska obitelj, pa kratak gin i tonik može poslužiti kao most prije jačeg destilata.
why.en: The spice family: a short gin and tonic can bridge before a stronger spirit.

q.en: Flor in sherry is…

a.hr: živi sloj kvasca na površini vina
a.en: a living layer of yeast on the wine's surface

why.hr: Flor je film kvasca koji troši kisik i štiti fino i manzanillu od oksidacije.
why.en: Flor is a yeast film that consumes oxygen and shields fino and manzanilla from oxidation.

q.hr: Koji je stil sherryja najsuhlji i najsvjetliji?
q.en: Which style of sherry is the driest and palest?

why.hr: Fino stari ispod flora, pa ostaje blijedo, suho i svježe.
why.en: Fino ages under flor, staying pale, dry and fresh.

q.hr: Po čemu se oloroso razlikuje od finog?
q.en: How does oloroso differ from fino?

a.en: it ages without flor and oxidises
it is always sweeter than PX

why.hr: Oloroso je jače fortificiran, flor ne preživi, pa vino oksidativno stari: tamnije i orašasto.
why.en: Oloroso is fortified higher, the flor cannot survive, so it ages oxidatively, darker and nutty.

q.en: Amontillado is a sherry that…

a.hr: počne kao fino pa nastavi oksidativno
a.en: starts as fino then ages oxidatively

a.hr: se radi samo od sušenog grožđa
a.en: is made only from dried grapes

why.hr: Flor odumre, pa amontillado spaja badem finog i orašastu dubinu olorosa.
why.en: The flor dies off, so amontillado bridges fino's almond and oloroso's nutty depth.

q.en: Manzanilla is a fino from…

why.hr: Priobalni Sanlúcar i vlažna morska klima hrane deblji flor, pa je manzanilla svježija i slankastija.
why.en: Coastal Sanlúcar's humid sea air feeds a thicker flor, so manzanilla is fresher and more saline.

q.en: Demerara rum comes from…

why.hr: Nazvan je po rijeci Demerari u Gvajani i destilira se na povijesnim drvenim alambicima.
why.en: It is named after the Demerara River in Guyana and distilled on historic wooden stills.

q.en: Cachaça is distilled from…

why.hr: Kao i agricole rum, cachaça koristi svježi sok trske; brazilska je i ima vlastita pravila.
why.en: Like agricole rum, cachaça uses fresh cane juice; it is Brazilian with its own rules.

q.en: Tequila reposado means it is…

why.hr: Reposado („odmoren”) stari 2–12 mjeseci; blanco je neodležan, añejo 1–3 g., extra añejo 3+ g.
why.en: Reposado ('rested') ages 2–12 months; blanco is unaged, añejo 1–3 yrs, extra añejo 3+ yrs.

q.hr: Po čemu je madeira poseban među vinima?
q.en: What makes madeira unusual among wines?

why.hr: Kontrolirano zagrijavanje i oksidacija čine je gotovo neuništivom, s notama karamele i oraha.
why.en: Controlled heating and oxidation make it almost indestructible, with caramel and walnut notes.

q.en: Rye whiskey must contain at least…

why.hr: Raž (u SAD-u ≥51 %) daje suši, papreno-začinski profil, drukčiji od slađeg bourbona.
why.en: Rye (≥51% in the USA) gives a drier, peppery-spicy profile, distinct from sweeter bourbon.

q.hr: Irski single pot still stil koristi…
q.en: The Irish single pot still style uses…

a.en: a mash of malted and unmalted barley

why.hr: Neslađeni ječam u pot stillu jedne destilerije daje kremastu, blago začinsku teksturu.
why.en: Unmalted barley in one distillery's pot still gives a creamy, lightly spicy texture.

q.hr: Whisky s otoka Islay tipično je…
q.en: Whisky from the isle of Islay is typically…

why.hr: Islay je poznat po tresetu i dimu; Speyside je voćan, a Lowlands lagan i cvjetan.
why.en: Islay is known for peat and smoke; Speyside is fruity and the Lowlands light and floral.

q.hr: Contemporary (New Western) gin razlikuje se od London Dry po tome što…
q.en: Contemporary (New Western) gin differs from London Dry in that…

a.hr: borovica ne dominira, vode drugi botanicali
a.en: juniper does not dominate, other botanicals lead

why.hr: Borovica mora biti prisutna, ali naprijed su citrus, cvijeće ili začini; London Dry stavlja borovicu u prvi plan.
why.en: Juniper must be present, but citrus, floral or spice lead; London Dry puts juniper up front.

q.en: Palo cortado is a sherry that…

a.hr: spaja finoću amontillada i tijelo olorosa
a.en: combines amontillado's finesse and oloroso's body

why.hr: Počne pod florom, flor rano nestane, pa spontano krene prema olorosu: fin nos, puno tijelo.
why.en: It starts under flor, loses it early and drifts to oloroso: a fine nose with a full body.

q.hr: „Sherry bomba” whisky svoje note suhog voća i oraha duguje…
q.en: A 'sherry bomb' whisky owes its dried-fruit and walnut notes to…

a.hr: bačvi u kojoj je prije bio sherry
a.en: a cask that previously held sherry

why.hr: Dozrijevanje u bivšim oloroso ili PX bačvama daje tamniji, slađi profil od bourbon bačve.
why.en: Maturation in former oloroso or PX casks gives a darker, sweeter profile than a bourbon barrel.

q.hr: U odnosu na kolonski (column) still, kotlasti (pot) still daje destilat koji je…
q.en: Compared with a column still, a pot still gives a spirit that is…

a.hr: puniji, s više okusa i teksture
a.en: fuller, with more flavour and texture

why.hr: Pot still radi šaržno i čuva više okusa; column still radi kontinuirano i daje čišći, lakši destilat.
why.en: A pot still works in batches and keeps more flavour; a column still runs continuously for a cleaner, lighter spirit.

q.hr: Zašto mezcal često ima dimni profil?
q.en: Why does mezcal often have a smoky profile?

a.hr: srca agave peku se u zemljanim jamama na ugljenu
a.en: the agave hearts are roasted in earthen charcoal pits

why.hr: Pečenje piñas u jamama daje dim; tequila je vrsta mezcala sa strožim pravilima i obično bez dima.
why.en: Roasting the piñas in pits gives smoke; tequila is a kind of mezcal with stricter rules and usually no smoke.

q.hr: Ligero list u punilu cigare dolazi s… i daje…
q.en: The ligero leaf in a cigar's filler comes from… and gives…

a.en: the bottom of the plant; an easier burn

a.hr: vrha biljke; snagu i sporo gorenje
a.en: the top of the plant; strength and a slow burn

why.hr: Ligero (vrh) nosi snagu i gori sporo, seco (sredina) aromu, volado (dno) pomaže gorenju.
why.en: Ligero (top) carries strength and burns slowly, seco (middle) aroma, volado (bottom) aids the burn.

q.en: A candela wrapper is recognised by its…

why.hr: Brzo, toplo sušenje „zaključa” klorofil pa list ostane zelen; profil je blag i travnat.
why.en: Fast, hot drying 'locks in' the chlorophyll so the leaf stays green; the profile is mild and grassy.

q.hr: Bijeli, praškasti sloj koji se lako otrese s dobro čuvane cigare je…
q.en: The white, powdery layer that brushes easily off a well-kept cigar is…

a.en: plume (bloom), a sign of good ageing

why.hr: Plume su iskristalizirana ulja i otresu se; plijesan je plavo-zelena, mrljasta i smrdi: to je kvar.
why.en: Plume is crystallised oils that brush off; mould is blue-green, blotchy and smelly, which is spoilage.

q.en: Cream sherry is actually…

why.hr: Suhom olorosu doda se slatko vino (obično PX); ime nema veze s vrhnjem.
why.en: A dry oloroso is blended with sweet wine (usually PX); the name has nothing to do with cream.

q.en: Late Bottled Vintage (LBV) port…

a.hr: dozrijeva 4–6 godina u bačvi i spreman je za piti
a.en: ages 4–6 years in cask and is ready to drink
is not from a single harvest

why.hr: Za razliku od vintage porta, LBV je duže u bačvi pa se obično ne mora dekantirati.
why.en: Unlike vintage port, LBV spends longer in cask, so it usually needs no decanting.

q.en: Old Tom gin is…

a.hr: blago zaslađen stil, između genevera i London Dry
a.en: a lightly sweetened style, between genever and London Dry

why.hr: Povijesni izbor za koktele Tom Collins i Martinez.
why.en: The historic choice for the Tom Collins and Martinez cocktails.

q.en: Genever (jenever) is…

a.hr: nizozemski predak gina od sladne baze
a.en: the Dutch malt-based ancestor of gin

why.hr: Sladna baza (moutwijn) daje žitniji, puniji profil; borovica je nježnija.
why.en: The malt base (moutwijn) gives a grainier, fuller profile; juniper is gentler.

q.en: A '100% agave' label on tequila means…

a.hr: sav šećer je iz plave agave
a.en: all the sugar comes from blue agave

why.hr: Bez te oznake je „mixto”: najmanje 51 % agave, ostatak drugi šećeri.
why.en: Without that label it is a 'mixto': at least 51% agave, the rest other sugars.

q.hr: Najveći dio mezcala radi se od agave…
q.en: Most mezcal is made from … agave

why.hr: Espadín brzo sazrijeva; divlje agave (tobalá) rastu godinama pa su rjeđe i skuplje.
why.en: Espadín matures fast; wild agaves (tobalá) take years, so they are rarer and pricier.

q.en: Retrohale with a cigar is…

a.en: exhaling some smoke through the nose
toasting the foot of the cigar

why.hr: Nos hvata arome koje jezik ne vidi (začini, cvijeće); radi se malom količinom.
why.en: The nose catches aromas the tongue misses (spice, floral); do it with a small amount.

q.en: The cold draw is done…

a.hr: prije paljenja, da provjeriš otpor i predokus
a.en: before lighting, to check resistance and preview flavour
only at the very end of the cigar

why.hr: Povlačenje zraka kroz nezapaljenu cigaru pokazuje otpor i note poput sijena ili kakaa.
why.en: Pulling air through an unlit cigar shows the resistance and notes such as hay or cocoa.

q.en: A panetela is a vitola that is…

why.hr: Tanji format daje svjetliji, brži dim; deblji format sporiji i puniji.
why.en: A thinner format gives a lighter, faster smoke; a thicker one slower and fuller.

q.en: An oscuro wrapper is…

why.hr: Duga, topla fermentacija daje intenzivne note kakaa, espressa i začina; tamniji je od madura.
why.en: Long, hot fermentation gives intense cocoa, espresso and spice; it is darker than maduro.

q.hr: „Bottled in Bond” jamči da je američki whiskey…
q.en: 'Bottled in Bond' guarantees the American whiskey is…

a.hr: iz jedne destilerije i sezone, 4+ g., točno 50 % alkohola
a.en: from one distillery and season, 4+ yrs, exactly 50% ABV

why.hr: Zakon iz 1897.: jedna destilerija i sezona, min. 4 g. u nadziranom skladištu, 50 % alkohola.
why.en: The 1897 law: one distillery and season, min. 4 yrs in a supervised warehouse, 50% ABV.

q.hr: Cask finish (dvostruko dozrijevanje) znači da whisky…
q.en: A cask finish (double maturation) means the whisky…

a.hr: provede dodatno vrijeme u drugoj bačvi (sherry, porto…)
a.en: spends extra time in a second cask (sherry, port…)

why.hr: Zadnja bačva dodaje sloj arome, ali ne smije potpuno prekriti whisky.
why.en: The final cask adds a layer of aroma without fully masking the whisky.

q.hr: Plemenita plijesan (botrytis) u velikim slatkim vinima…
q.en: Noble rot (botrytis) in great sweet wines…

a.hr: koncentrira šećer i aromu u grožđu
a.en: concentrates sugar and aroma in the grape

why.hr: Gljivica probuši kožicu, voda ispari, šećer se koncentrira; stoji iza Tokajija i Sauternesa.
why.en: The fungus pierces the skin, water evaporates, sugar concentrates; behind Tokaji and Sauternes.

q.hr: U odnosu na arabicu, robusta kava…
q.en: Compared with arabica, robusta coffee…

a.hr: ima više kofeina i gorča je
a.en: has more caffeine and is more bitter

why.hr: Robusta daje gušću cremu i više kofeina; klasični espresso često miješa obje vrste.
why.en: Robusta gives a thicker crema and more caffeine; classic espresso often blends the two.

q.en: A box-pressed cigar is recognised by its…

why.hr: Pritisak u kutiji ili kalupu daje ravne bokove i često mirniji, koncentriraniji dim.
why.en: Pressure in the box or a mould gives flat sides and often a calmer, more concentrated draw.

q.en: Why is vintage port decanted?

a.hr: jer desetljećima stari u boci i taloži se
a.en: because it ages for decades in the bottle and throws a sediment

why.hr: Vintage je kratko u bačvi (2–3 g.) pa nastavlja u boci i stvara talog; tawny se ne mora dekantirati.
why.en: Vintage spends little time in cask (2–3 yrs) and continues in the bottle, forming sediment; tawny needs no decanting.

q.en: En rama sherry is…

a.hr: sherry punjen s malo ili nimalo filtracije
a.en: sherry bottled with little or no filtration

why.hr: Bliži je okusu ravno iz bačve: puniji, kvasniji i „življi”; često sezonski.
why.en: It is closer to the cask taste: fuller, yeastier and more 'alive'; often a seasonal release.

q.en: A single quinta port is…

a.en: a vintage port from a single estate

why.hr: Obično iz godina koje nisu proglašene „klasičnom” berbom; vintage stil po pristupačnijoj cijeni.
why.en: Usually from years not declared a 'classic' vintage: the vintage style at a friendlier price.

q.hr: VORS na sherryju označava prosječnu starost od oko…
q.en: VORS on sherry marks an average age of about…

why.hr: VOS je ~20 godina, VORS ~30; rijetke, koncentrirane boce olorosa, amontillada ili PX-a.
why.en: VOS is ~20 years, VORS ~30; rare, concentrated bottles of oloroso, amontillado or PX.

q.hr: Overproof rum je rum s alkoholom…
q.en: Overproof rum is rum with alcohol…

why.hr: Intenzivan i vruć, rijetko se pije čist; dobar za koktele i snažne cigare.
why.en: Intense and hot, rarely sipped neat; good for cocktails and powerful cigars.

q.en: The NOM on tequila denotes…

why.hr: Više marki može dijeliti isti NOM jer izlaze iz iste destilerije.
why.en: Several brands can share the same NOM because they come from the same distillery.

q.en: Tannins give the palate…

a.en: a dry, gripping feel (like strong tea)

why.hr: Dolaze iz kožice i sjemenki grožđa te iz hrasta (bačve); daju strukturu i s vremenom omekšaju.
why.en: They come from grape skins and seeds and from oak (barrels); they give structure and soften with time.

q.en: Cold brew coffee is made…

a.en: by steeping in cold water for 12–24 hours

why.hr: Blaga je, slatkasta i niske kiselosti; espresso je suprotnost, gust i intenzivan.
why.en: It is mild, sweetish and low in acidity; espresso is the opposite, dense and intense.

q.en: Terroir in a drink means…

a.hr: zbir tla, klime i mjesta koji se osjeti
a.en: the sum of soil, climate and place you can taste

why.hr: Zato isti stil drukčije zvuči iz različitih krajeva, i kad je tehnika ista.
why.en: That is why the same style reads differently by region, even with identical technique.

q.en: A V-cut on a cigar…

a.en: focuses the smoke to the centre of the cap
punches a small hole in the cap
cuts the whole cap straight off

why.hr: Giljotina daje ravan rez i najviše otvara draw; punch daje uži, topliji draw.
why.en: The guillotine is a straight cut that opens the draw most; the punch gives a tighter, warmer draw.

q.en: 'Toasting' the foot when lighting means…

a.hr: grijati rub stopala bez izravnog dodira plamena
a.en: warming the rim of the foot without the flame touching it

why.hr: Tako se izbjegne zagoren, oštar prvi dim.
why.en: This avoids a scorched, harsh first puff.

q.en: Purging a cigar is…

a.hr: nježno ispuhivanje zraka kad postane vruća i gorka
a.en: gently blowing air out when it turns hot and bitter

why.hr: Izbaci nakupljeni oštri dim pa se okus vrati; radi se rijetko i tiho.
why.en: It clears the built-up harsh smoke so flavour returns; do it rarely and quietly.

q.en: Which end of a cigar do you light?

why.hr: Kapa (glava) se reže i drži u ustima; stopalo je otvoreni kraj koji gori.
why.en: The cap is cut and held in the mouth; the foot is the open end that burns.

q.en: A lancero is a vitola that is…

a.en: long and thin, highlighting the wrapper

why.hr: Oko 7,5 x 38–40, s malom „nožicom”; daje elegantan, precizan dim.
why.en: About 7.5 x 38–40, with a small pigtail; an elegant, precise smoke.

q.hr: Zašto friško dostavljena cigara nakon pauze zna pušiti bolje?
q.en: Why does a freshly delivered cigar often smoke better after a pause?

a.hr: jer odmor u humidoru ujednači vlagu i smiri okuse
a.en: because rest in the humidor evens the moisture and calms the flavours

why.hr: Cigare se, kao i pića, „slegnu” odmaranjem nakon transporta.
why.en: Cigars, like drinks, settle with rest after shipping.

q.hr: Koja se sorta tradicionalno koristi za pokrov?
q.en: Which variety was traditionally used for the wrapper?

why.hr: Corojo se tradicionalno koristi za pokrov, a Criollo za punilo i vezni list.
why.en: Corojo was traditionally used for the wrapper, Criollo for filler and binder.

q.en: A cigar's cap should be cut…

a.en: just above the flag (the small piece of leaf)
all the way down the head

why.hr: Rez iznad flaga drži pokrov na mjestu; prevelik rez ga može olabaviti.
why.en: Cutting above the flag keeps the wrapper in place; too deep a cut can loosen it.

q.en: Canoeing on a cigar is…

a.hr: neravnomjerno gorenje kad jedna strana gori brže
a.en: an uneven burn where one side burns faster

why.hr: Žar poprimi oblik kanua; popravlja se okretanjem i dogorijevanjem sporije strane.
why.en: The ember takes a canoe shape; fix it by rotating and touching up the slower side.

q.en: Tunneling means that…

a.en: it is a type of wrapper
the core burns ahead of the wrapper

why.hr: Nastaje „tunel” jer pokrov zaostaje; sprječava ga ravnomjerno paljenje i redovito povlačenje.
why.en: A 'tunnel' forms as the wrapper lags; an even light and steady draws prevent it.

q.en: If a cigar goes out…

a.hr: smije se ponovno zapaliti uz otresen pepeo i tost
a.en: it may be relit after knocking off ash and re-toasting

a.hr: pali se samo jednom u životu
a.en: it is lit only once ever

why.hr: U razumnoj mjeri relight ne kvari okus; problem je tek dugo stajala, hladna cigara.
why.en: Within reason a relight does not spoil the taste; only a long-cold cigar turns bitter.

q.en: A cedar spill is…

a.hr: tanka trakica cedra kojom se pali cigara
a.en: a thin strip of cedar used to light a cigar

why.hr: Nema mirisa goriva, a cedar suptilno naglasi arome.
why.en: No fuel smell, and the cedar subtly lifts the aromas.

q.en: The vitola de salida is…

a.en: the commercial format name on the box
the factory name used by rollers

why.hr: Vitola de galera je tvornički naziv (npr. „Julieta”), a de salida trgovački (npr. „Churchill”).
why.en: The vitola de galera is the factory name (e.g. 'Julieta'), the de salida the commercial one (e.g. 'Churchill').

q.en: The nub is…

a.en: the first puff of a cigar

a.hr: zadnji, najkraći dio cigare pri kraju
a.en: the last, shortest part near the end

why.hr: Nema pravila dokle se puši: dok je dim hladan i ugodan smiješ do kraja.
why.en: No rule on how far to go: while the smoke stays cool and pleasant you may finish it.

q.en: The cellophane on a cigar…

a.hr: ne propušta zrak i guši cigaru
a.en: blocks air and suffocates the cigar

a.hr: propušta zrak, cigare mogu godinama stajati u njemu
a.en: lets air through, cigars can rest in it for years

why.hr: Cello olakšava razvrstavanje, ali ne zamjenjuje ispravnu vlagu humidora.
why.en: Cello makes sorting easier but does not replace correct humidor humidity.

q.en: Šljivovica is distilled from…

why.hr: Rakija je balkanska voćna rakija; ima je i od grožđa (loza), kruške ili marelice.
why.en: Rakija is a Balkan fruit brandy; also made from grapes (loza), pear or apricot.

q.en: Marc is…

a.hr: francuska rakija od komine (kožice i sjemenki)
a.en: a French pomace brandy (skins and seeds)

why.hr: Rođak grappe; španjolska inačica je orujo, njemačka Trester.
why.en: A cousin of grappa; the Spanish version is orujo, the German Trester.

q.en: A single barrel whisky comes…

a.en: from a blend of many casks

a.hr: iz jedne jedine bačve, bez miješanja
a.en: from one single cask, with no blending

why.hr: Zato svaka boca zna malo odstupati; često se navode broj bačve i datum punjenja.
why.en: So each bottling can differ slightly; the cask number and date are often listed.

q.en: New make (white dog) is…

a.hr: bistri destilat ravno s alambika, prije bačve
a.en: the clear spirit straight off the still, before the cask

why.hr: Boju i većinu poznatih aroma whisky dobiva tek dozrijevanjem u hrastu.
why.en: Whisky gets its colour and most familiar aromas only from oak ageing.

q.en: Which sparkling wine has the least sugar?

why.hr: Ljestvica od suhog prema slatkom: brut nature, extra brut, brut, extra dry, sec, demi-sec, doux.
why.en: Dry to sweet scale: brut nature, extra brut, brut, extra dry, sec, demi-sec, doux.

q.en: A dark roast brings coffee…

a.en: always less caffeine than a light roast

a.hr: gorčinu, tijelo i dimne, čokoladne tonove
a.en: bitterness, body and smoky, chocolatey tones

why.hr: Svijetlo prženje čuva kiselost i voće, srednje ravnotežu i karamelu.
why.en: A light roast keeps acidity and fruit, a medium roast balance and caramel.

q.hr: Po čemu se vintage razlikuje od solere?
q.en: How does a vintage differ from a solera?

a.en: both are from a single harvest

a.hr: vintage je jedna berba, solera stalno miješa mlađe sa starijim
a.en: a vintage is one harvest, a solera keeps blending younger into older

why.hr: Vintage nosi pečat svoje godine; solera daje ujednačen stil iz boce u bocu.
why.en: A vintage carries its year's stamp; a solera gives a consistent style bottle to bottle.

q.hr: Koji je od navedenih pjenušaca najslađi?
q.en: Which of these sparkling wines is the sweetest?

why.hr: Demi-sec je znatno slađi od svih brut kategorija.
why.en: Demi-sec is markedly sweeter than any of the brut categories.

q.hr: Orujo (Španjolska) i Trester (Njemačka) lokalni su nazivi za…
q.en: Orujo (Spain) and Trester (Germany) are local names for…

a.hr: rakiju od komine, kao grappa i marc
a.en: pomace brandy, like grappa and marc

why.hr: Sve su to destilati komine (kožice i sjemenke grožđa) pod različitim imenima.
why.en: All are pomace spirits (grape skins and seeds) under different names.

q.en: Orange wine is made by…

a.hr: duljom maceracijom bijelog grožđa s kožicama
a.en: longer skin contact with white grapes

a.hr: dodavanjem narančinog soka u bijelo vino
a.en: adding orange juice to white wine

a.hr: samo od crvenog grožđa bez kožica
a.en: only from red grapes with no skins

why.hr: Kožice bijelog grožđa daju boju, tanin i začin, pa vino nije „obično” bijelo.
why.en: White-grape skins give colour, tannin and spice, so it is not a plain white.

q.hr: Junmai sake razlikuje se od honjozoa time što…
q.en: Junmai sake differs from honjozo in that it…

a.hr: radi se od ječma, ne od riže
a.en: is made from barley, not rice

why.hr: Junmai ostaje na riži, vodi, kojiiju i kvascu; honjozo smije imati malo dodanog alkohola.
why.en: Junmai stays on rice, water, koji and yeast; honjozo may include a little added spirit.

q.en: Kirsch is…

a.en: a red wine made from cherries

why.hr: Kirsch je destilat, neat i hladan, ne kremasti liker.
why.en: Kirsch is a distillate, neat and cold, not a cream liqueur.

q.en: Foreshots in distillation are…

a.en: the sweetest part of the cask

a.hr: prvi, oštri odsječak destilata koji se odvaja
a.en: the first, harsh cut of distillate that is set aside

why.hr: Glava destilacije ide na stranu; u čašu ide srce.
why.en: The heads are set aside; the heart goes into the glass.

q.en: Vermouth is primarily…

why.hr: Baza je vino; bilje i alkohol grade stil.
why.en: The base is wine; herbs and spirit build the style.

q.hr: Zašto biljni gorki liker često ide nakon dima?
q.en: Why does a bitter herbal liqueur often follow smoke?

a.en: because it replaces water in the humidifier

why.hr: Gorčina i bilje skidaju masnoću dima s jezika.
why.en: Bitterness and herbs lift smoke fat off the tongue.

q.en: Pedro Ximénez (PX) is…

a.hr: vrlo slatki sherry od sunčanih grožđa
a.en: a very sweet sherry from sunned grapes

why.hr: PX je gust i desertan; gutlja se štedljivo uz cigaru.
why.en: PX is thick and dessert-like; sip it sparingly with a cigar.

q.en: A typical aquavit seasoning is…

why.hr: Skandinavski profil stoji na kimu ili kopru.
why.en: The Scandinavian profile rests on caraway or dill.

q.en: Calvados is distilled from…

why.hr: Normandijski brandy od jabuka, ne od žitarica ili agave.
why.en: Normandy apple brandy, not grain or agave.

q.hr: Armagnac se od cognaca često razlikuje…
q.en: Armagnac often differs from cognac by…

a.hr: jednokratnom destilacijom u kontinuiranom stupcu i rustikalnijim stilom
a.en: a single continuous-column pass and a more rustic style

why.hr: Cognac je tipično pot still i stroži kraj; Armagnac često ide kroz stupac.
why.en: Cognac is typically pot-still and tightly regional; Armagnac often uses a column.

q.hr: Joven ili crystal mezcal u čaši ističe…
q.en: Joven or crystal mezcal in the glass highlights…

a.hr: agavu i peć, bez (ili s malo) bačvastog sloja
a.en: agave and oven, with little or no cask layer

why.hr: Bez duljeg odležavanja vode agava i pečenje.
why.en: Without long ageing, agave and roast lead.

q.hr: Mosto u proizvodnji tequile ili mezcala je…
q.en: Mosto in tequila or mezcal making is…

a.en: the finished bottle on the shelf

why.hr: Fermentacija gradi okus koji destilacija kasnije koncentrira.
why.en: Fermentation builds flavour that distillation later concentrates.

q.hr: Aromatizirano vino (npr. vermut) nije isto što i…
q.en: Aromatised wine (e.g. vermouth) is not the same as…

a.hr: fortificirano vino koje se prvenstveno ojačava alkoholom radi stila
a.en: fortified wine strengthened mainly with spirit for style
a category that can include herbs

why.hr: Fortifikacija i aromatizacija su različiti postupci, iako se ponekad preklapaju.
why.en: Fortifying and aromatising are different steps, even if they sometimes overlap.

q.en: Pastis with water typically…

a.hr: postaje potpuno proziran i bez okusa

why.hr: Voda izaziva zamućenje i pije se kao aperitiv.
why.en: Water causes clouding and it is drunk as an aperitif.

q.hr: Uz maduro desertnu večer PX sherry najbolje ide…
q.en: With a maduro dessert evening, PX sherry works best…

a.hr: u velikim gutljajima uz svaki dim
a.en: in large gulps with every puff

a.hr: štedljivo, gotovo žličicom, zbog gustoće i slatkoće
a.en: sparingly, almost by the spoon, because of density and sweetness

why.hr: Gusta slatkoća brzo umara nepce ako se natapa.
why.en: Thick sweetness tires the palate if you flood it.

q.en: Aquavit with a cigar more often suits…

a.hr: blagu ili Connecticut liniju nego teški maduro
a.en: a mild or Connecticut line rather than a heavy maduro

why.hr: Čist, začinski profil lakše nosi laganiji dim.
why.en: A clean, spicy profile carries lighter smoke more easily.

q.en: A torcedor in the factory…

why.hr: Uvijanje je tvornički zanat; sommelier servira gostu.
why.en: Rolling is factory craft; the sommelier serves the guest.

q.en: A two-way humidity pack…

a.hr: i otpušta i upija vlagu prema ciljanom RH
a.en: both releases and absorbs moisture toward a target RH

why.hr: Membrana drži ravnotežu, ne samo „mokru spužvu”.
why.en: The membrane holds balance, not only a wet sponge.

q.en: Plume (bloom) on a cigar…

a.hr: uvijek znači da cigaru treba baciti
a.en: always means the cigar must be thrown away

a.hr: je mokra zelena plijesan s jakim mirisom
a.en: is wet green mould with a strong smell

a.hr: suhi je kristal ulja bez mirisa plijesni i može se obrisati
a.en: is a dry oil crystal with no mould smell and can be brushed off

why.hr: Plijesan miriše i izgleda pamučasto; plume je suh i mirisan na duhan.
why.en: Mould smells and looks cottony; plume is dry and tobacco-scented.

q.en: In a strong wind the wisest move is…

a.hr: držati plamen u vjetar cijelo vrijeme
a.en: hold the flame into the wind the whole time
shorten the session or find shelter

why.hr: Vjetar kvari gorenje i peče jezik; zavjetrina spašava sesiju.
why.en: Wind ruins the burn and scorches the tongue; shelter saves the session.

q.en: Behike is…

a.en: a line within the Cohiba brand

why.hr: Ime linije na kutiji, ne nova marka sama za sebe.
why.en: A line name on the box, not a brand on its own.

q.en: Why is a new humidor seasoned?

a.hr: da suhi cedar ne povuče vlagu iz cigara
a.en: so dry cedar does not pull moisture from cigars

why.hr: Sirovo drvo je žedno; prvo se napoji, pa tek cigare.
why.en: Raw wood is thirsty; wet it first, then add cigars.

q.hr: Praktičan raspon RH za većinu cigara je…
q.en: A practical RH range for most cigars is…

why.hr: Srednji raspon drži omot cijelim bez plijesni.
why.en: The mid range keeps the wrapper intact without mould.

q.en: The salt test for a hygrometer targets about…

why.hr: Zasićena solna kaša u zatvorenoj posudi daje poznatu referentnu točku.
why.en: A saturated salt slurry in a closed jar gives a known reference point.

q.en: FIFO in the humidor means…

a.hr: starije kutije prve na red za pušenje
a.en: older boxes first in line to smoke

a.hr: samo nove kutije se smiju otvoriti
a.en: only new boxes may be opened
cigars are kept in the freezer

why.hr: Rotacija sprječava zaboravljene kutije u kutu.
why.en: Rotation prevents forgotten boxes in the corner.

q.en: Ash while smoking…

a.en: should be scraped off the wrapper with a nail

a.hr: pusti da naraste pa ga nježno odloži; ne treši svaku sekundu
a.en: let it grow, then rest it gently; do not flick every second
must fall on the floor for ‘luck’

why.hr: Mirno odlaganje čuva žar i odijelo.
why.en: Calm resting protects the coal and your clothes.

q.hr: Dobar ritam para pića i cigare je…
q.en: A good drink-and-cigar tempo is…

a.hr: gutljaj uz svaki pojedini dim bez stanke
a.en: a sip with every single puff and no pause
drink only, cigar as an afterthought

a.hr: nekoliko dimova, pa gutljaj, pa stanka
a.en: a few puffs, then a sip, then a pause

why.hr: Stanka čuva i čašu i dim čitljivima.
why.en: Pauses keep both glass and smoke readable.

q.en: Remove the cigar band…

a.en: cold, the moment you open the box

a.hr: tek kad se ljepilo ugrije i omot omekša
a.en: only once the glue warms and the wrapper softens

why.hr: Hladno čupanje cijepa pokrov.
why.en: Cold yanking splits the wrapper.

q.en: Spanish cedar in a humidor…

a.en: only decorates the lid on the outside

a.hr: zamjenjuje potrebu za bilo kakvom vlagom
mora biti mokar do kapanja cijelo vrijeme
pomaže mirisu i stabilnosti vlage kad je pravilno začinjen
a.en: helps aroma and humidity stability when properly seasoned

why.hr: Cedar je obloga i pufer, ne čarobni štapić bez RH.
why.en: Cedar is lining and buffer, not magic without RH.

q.en: A cigar sommelier for a guest…

a.hr: bira, predlaže i pomaže oko reza, paljenja i para
a.en: selects, recommends and helps with cut, light and pairing

a.hr: mora osobno uviti svaku cigaru za stolom
a.en: must hand-roll every cigar at the table
only charges for the box in silence

why.hr: Servis i savjet, ne tvorničko uvijanje za stolom.
why.en: Service and advice, not factory rolling at the table.

q.hr: Pretjerano visok RH u humidoru rizik je za…
q.en: Excessively high RH in a humidor risks…

a.hr: jači okus vanilije u svakoj cigari

why.hr: Previše vlage voli plijesan i guši gorenje.
why.en: Too much moisture loves mould and chokes the burn.

q.hr: U tvorničkoj podjeli rada kontrola kvalitete…
q.en: In factory division of labour, quality control…

a.hr: stoji uz sortiranje, uvijanje i kutiju kao zaseban korak
a.en: stands beside sorting, rolling and boxing as its own step
does not exist in the tobacco industry

a.hr: radi se isključivo nakon pet godina u humidoru kupca
a.en: happens only after five years in the customer’s humidor
replaces the need for a wrapper

why.hr: QC je dio lanca prije nego kutija krene na put.
why.en: QC is part of the chain before the box ships.

q.en: A triple cap on a cigar is…

a.en: a three-layer finish of the head with wrapper pieces

a.hr: tri različita punila u jednoj kutiji
a.en: three different fillers in one box

why.hr: Završni sloj na glavi, ne recept punila.
why.en: A finishing layer on the head, not a filler recipe.

q.hr: Ako je draw pretijesan, loš prvi korak je…
q.en: If the draw is too tight, a bad first step is…

a.en: a gentle massage along the cigar
violent sucking until you turn red
checking whether the cut is enough

a.hr: zamjena cigare ako je unutra čep
a.en: switching cigars if a plug sits inside

why.hr: Sila peče i ne otvara čep; miran popravak ili druga cigara.
why.en: Force scorches and does not clear a plug; calm fix or another cigar.

q.en: The binder leaf…

a.en: is only the sticker on the box
holds the filler under the wrapper

why.hr: Vezni list je konstrukcija; pokrov je koža.
why.en: Binder is structure; wrapper is the skin.

q.en: A plug in a cigar…

a.hr: dokaz je da je cedar svjež

a.en: blocks the draw with packed tobacco

why.hr: Zato gotovo nema dima iako vučeš jako.
why.en: That is why there is almost no smoke despite pulling.

q.en: A small wrapper unravel…

a.hr: može se nježno priljubiti vlagom prsta u smjeru uvijanja
a.en: can be gently pressed back with finger moisture along the roll

a.hr: znači da je cijela kutija pokvarena
a.en: means the whole box is ruined

a.hr: popravlja se samo u tvornici na Kubi
a.en: is repaired only in a Cuban factory

why.hr: Mali rub da; veliko kidanje završava sesiju.
why.en: A small edge yes; a big tear ends the session.

q.en: Touch-up lighting is for…

a.en: when one side of the coal lags

a.hr: kad želiš brže potrošiti cijelu kutiju
a.en: when you want to finish the whole box faster
only before putting the band on
only with ice in the glass

why.hr: Kratko podgrij rub, ne peči cijelu cigaru.
why.en: Warm the rim briefly; do not scorch the whole cigar.

q.hr: Kad dim postane vruć i gorak…
q.en: When smoke turns hot and bitter…

a.hr: uspori, napravi stanke i popij vode
a.en: slow down, pause and drink water
close the humidor while you smoke

why.hr: Temperatura i ritam spašavaju ostatak cigare.
why.en: Temperature and pace save the rest of the cigar.

q.hr: Otvoreno fino sherry u usporedbi s otvorenim whiskyjem…
q.en: Open fino sherry compared with open whisky…

a.hr: traje jednako dugo u svim uvjetima
a.en: lasts equally long in all conditions
lasts longer because it is stronger
does not exist in bottle form

a.hr: brže gubi svježinu; potroši ga ranije
a.en: loses freshness faster; finish it sooner

why.hr: Visok alkohol žestokog bolje podnosi zrak nego krhki fino.
why.en: High-strength spirits handle air better than fragile fino.

q.hr: Tulipan ili ballon čaša za žestoko…
q.en: A tulip or balloon glass for spirits…

a.hr: služi samo za led bez pića
a.en: is only for ice with no drink

why.hr: Oblik vodi miris; tumbler više hladi s ledom.
why.en: Shape guides scent; a tumbler chills more with ice.

q.hr: Led uz kompleksnu bačvu i maduro često…
q.en: Ice with a complex cask and a maduro often…

a.en: must be made from sparkling wine
dilutes and chills the palate too fast

why.hr: Neat ili kap vode često čuvaju više arome.
why.en: Neat or a drop of water often keeps more aroma.

q.en: Water in a pairing session…

a.hr: resetira nepce između dima i gutljaja
a.en: resets the palate between smoke and sip
replaces the need for an ashtray
removes the band from the cigar

why.hr: Jednostavan reset bez novog koktela.
why.en: A simple reset without another cocktail.

q.en: Filler in a cigar primarily…

a.en: is the outer wrap for photos
is only ink on the box

a.hr: gradi tijelo okusa i snagu mješavinom lista
a.en: builds flavour body and strength via the leaf blend

why.hr: Punilo je motor; vezni list drži, pokrov obuče.
why.en: Filler is the engine; binder holds, wrapper dresses.

q.en: Sorting wrapper leaf looks at…

a.hr: veličinu, boju i elastičnost, ne samo boju
a.en: size, colour and elasticity, not colour alone
only the price at a tobacco auction
only the country on the buyer’s passport

why.hr: Elastičnost i veličina određuju hoće li list ići kao omot.
why.en: Elasticity and size decide whether a leaf becomes wrapper.

q.en: An overly open draw often means…

a.hr: da se mora dodati led u humidor
a.en: that ice must be added to the humidor

a.hr: vruće, brzo gorenje i kraći užitak
a.en: hot, fast burning and a shorter pleasure

why.hr: Previše zraka tjera temperaturu gore.
why.en: Too much air drives temperature up.

q.en: Congeners are…

a.hr: aromatični spojevi uz alkohol iz fermentacije i destilacije
a.en: aromatic compounds formed with alcohol in fermentation and distillation

why.hr: Tamna, bogata pića imaju ih više: više okusa, ali i teže „posljedice”.
why.en: Dark, rich spirits carry more: more flavour, but also a heavier next day.

q.hr: Koji dio destilata destiler zadržava kao najbolji?
q.en: Which part of the run does the distiller keep as the best?

why.hr: Glave su oštre i hlapljive, repovi teški i uljni; srce je pitki dio.
why.en: Heads are harsh and volatile, tails heavy and oily; the heart is the drinkable cut.

q.en: In the USA, 'proof' is…

why.hr: Nastao iz mornaričkog testa barutom; danas stoji uz ABV.
why.en: It grew out of the navy's gunpowder test; today it sits alongside ABV.

q.en: Grain whisky is…

a.hr: od ječmenog slada u pot stillu
a.en: from malted barley in a pot still

a.hr: od žitarica u kolonskom stillu, lakši i neutralniji
a.en: from grains in a column still, lighter and more neutral

why.hr: Blended scotch miješa malt (karakter) i grain (mekoća).
why.en: Blended scotch mixes malt (character) and grain (smoothness).

q.en: Cristalino tequila is…

why.hr: Ugljen ukloni boju, ali ostane dio hrastove mekoće; izgleda kao blanco.
why.en: Charcoal strips the colour but keeps some oak smoothness; it looks like a blanco.

q.hr: Tequila od agave iz visoravni Los Altos obično je…
q.en: Tequila from Los Altos highland agave is usually…

why.hr: Nizinska agava (Valles) daje zemljaniji, biljni, papreniji stil.
why.en: Lowland (Valles) agave gives an earthier, herbal, peppery style.

q.en: Sloe gin is…

a.hr: liker od gina i trnjina, sladak
a.en: a liqueur of gin and sloes, sweet

why.hr: Gin se macerira s trnjinama i šećerom; klasičan zimski aperitiv.
why.en: Gin is macerated with sloes and sugar; a classic winter sipper.

q.en: Marsala is…

why.hr: Ide od suhog (secco) do slatkog (dolce); suhe, starije verzije idu uz cigaru.
why.en: It runs dry (secco) to sweet (dolce); dry, older versions pair with a cigar.

q.en: Ice wine (Eiswein) is made from…

a.en: grapes harvested frozen on the vine

why.hr: Led zadrži vodu pa se cijedi samo koncentriran, sladak sok.
why.en: The ice holds back water, so only concentrated, sweet juice is pressed.

q.en: A 'corked' wine means…

a.hr: manu (TCA) koja miriše na vlažan karton
a.en: a fault (TCA) smelling of wet cardboard

why.hr: Mana iz čepa nije opasna, ali voće nestane i vino je pokvareno.
why.en: The cork fault is harmless but the fruit disappears and the wine is spoiled.

q.en: A barber pole cigar is…

a.hr: cigara s dva pokrova u spirali
a.en: a cigar with two wrappers in a spiral

why.hr: Spaja dva profila omota (npr. Connecticut i maduro) u istom dimu.
why.en: It blends two wrapper profiles (e.g. Connecticut and maduro) in one smoke.

q.en: A shaggy foot is…

a.en: a foot tapered to a tip (perfecto)

a.hr: stopalo s izloženim punjenjem bez pokrova
a.en: a foot with exposed filler and no wrapper

why.hr: Izložen punjenje daje mekši start; zatvoreno (perfecto) stopalo ističe pokrov.
why.en: Exposed filler gives a softer start; a closed (perfecto) foot highlights the wrapper.

q.en: Turkish coffee is…

a.hr: fino mljevena, kuhana i nefiltrirana, s talogom
a.en: finely ground, simmered and unfiltered, with grounds

why.hr: Gusta je i jaka; ne miješa se prije nego se talog slegne.
why.en: Thick and strong; do not stir before the grounds settle.

q.en: A moka pot gives…

a.hr: jak, koncentriran napitak parom, ali ne pod tlakom espressa
a.en: a strong, steam-driven brew, but not at espresso pressure

why.hr: Gušći od filtra, ali bez visokog tlaka pravog espressa.
why.en: Thicker than filter, but without true espresso's high pressure.

q.hr: Whisky od 40 % ABV u SAD-u ima… proof
q.en: A 40% ABV whisky in the USA is … proof

why.hr: US proof je dvostruki ABV: 40 % = 80 proof.
why.en: US proof is twice the ABV: 40% = 80 proof.

q.hr: Koja pića tipično imaju više kongenera?
q.en: Which drinks typically have more congeners?

a.hr: tamna, bogata pića (bourbon, brandy, tamni rum)
a.en: dark, rich spirits (bourbon, brandy, dark rum)

why.hr: Zato tamna pića nose više okusa, ali i teže „posljedice”.
why.en: So dark spirits carry more flavour, but also a heavier next day.

q.hr: Što radiš s cigarom na kraju večeri?
q.en: What do you do with the cigar at the end of the evening?

a.hr: ostaviš je u pepeljari da se sama ugasi
a.en: leave it in the ashtray to go out on its own
stub it out like a cigarette
drop it into a water glass

why.hr: Stubanje širi neugodan miris; pepeo i žar mirno ugasnu u pepeljari.
why.en: Stubbing spreads a foul smell; ash and coal die quietly in the tray.

q.hr: Zajednički rezač u salonu — smiješ li navlažiti cap slinom prije reza?
q.en: Shared lounge cutter — may you wet the cap with saliva before cutting?

a.en: no — hygiene and a shared tool

why.hr: Cap ne ide u usta prije zajedničkog rezača; koristi svoj ili čist kućni.
why.en: Do not put the cap in your mouth before a shared cutter; use your own or a clean house tool.

q.hr: Limited edition (LE) cigara za stolom znači…
q.en: A limited edition (LE) cigar at the table means…

a.hr: da si bolji gost od onoga s redovnom linijom
a.en: you are a better guest than someone with a regular line

a.hr: ograničenu proizvodnju — razgovor o duhanu, ne o cijeni kao dokazu
a.en: finite production — talk tobacco, not price as proof
automatically a costlier and better blend
that you must pay a cut fee

why.hr: LE je oznaka količine/riječnosti; bonton traži priču o duhanu, ne flex cijene.
why.en: LE marks quantity/rarity; manners ask for a tobacco story, not a price flex.

q.en: Whisky in a glass bottle…

a.en: stops ageing once it leaves the cask

a.hr: stari samo ako je cask strength
a.en: ages only if it is cask strength

why.hr: Starenje je u bačvi; u boci tekućina čeka otvaranje i dijeljenje.
why.en: Ageing happens in cask; in bottle the liquid waits to be opened and shared.

q.hr: Kad vodiš degustaciju s više boca uz cigaru, koliko stavki je razumno?
q.en: When hosting a multi-bottle tasting with a cigar, how many items is sensible?

a.hr: pet do šest, od blažeg prema jačem
a.en: five to six, milder to bolder

why.hr: Više od šest zamućuje nepce; redoslijed blago→jako i voda između štite usporedbu.
why.en: More than six blurs the palate; milder→bolder order and water between protect comparison.
